I used to love Splitwise—they had heaps of features that no other competitor offered and it was the perfect way to balance expenses in larger groups. We would happily pay for Pro to easily scan and itemize receipts into our groups and settle up. Categorization and simplifications were great features. But as time went on, instead of offering new and compelling features, they paywalled nearly everything useful that gave them the advantage. Venmo groups ate Splitwise’s lunch when it comes to the basic concept of entering an expense. There is absolutely no reason why a free account should be limited on the number of expenses it can enter per day, or there to be a delay between entering expenses. Bank connections are a joke, there’s no way to connect payment options like Zelle despite being one of the most requested features for almost 10 years now. There is no trust in the app to perform its basic function and charging users for absolutely everything drove each and every one of my friends away from the app. I wish they could turn it around and be honest with themselves about the value of their subscription, but until that happens I wouldn’t recommend using the app to anyone. For example, it appears the standard version is limited to one expense submission per day l and I also find the 10 seconds countdown to submit an expense aggravating. splitwise|es.t: De app gratuita con anuncios a casi inutilizable
splitwise|es.c:
Llevo tiempo usando Splitwise y el cambio en la versión gratuita me parece lamentable. Antes, después de varios gastos, aparecía publicidad durante unos 10 segundos y después podías seguir añadiendo gastos. Era molesto, pero entendible para una aplicación gratuita.

Ahora la situación es completamente diferente: desde el primer gasto del día ya aparece publicidad para que contrates la versión Pro, con el segundo vuelve a pasar y, al intentar añadir un tercero, directamente no te deja continuar. Es decir, en la práctica han limitado la versión gratuita a solo dos gastos al día si no pagas.

Entiendo perfectamente que una aplicación necesite monetizarse y que exista una versión Pro con ventajas, pero una cosa es ofrecer funciones adicionales de pago y otra convertir una función básica que llevaba años disponible en una limitación tan extrema para empujar al usuario a suscribirse.

Una pena, porque Splitwise me parecía una aplicación muy útil y la utilizaba precisamente por su sencillez. Con este cambio, para mí ha perdido gran parte de su utilidad.

Splitwise es una aplicación muy útil para gestionar deudas y gastos compartidos de forma sencilla y transparente. Resulta especialmente práctica para familias, incluso para llevar cuentas con hijos, ya sea para pagas, gastos comunes, adelantos o actividades compartidas.

La app permite registrar quién paga cada cosa y cómo se reparte el gasto, mostrando en todo momento quién debe a quién y cuánto. Esto ayuda a evitar confusiones, discusiones y olvidos, y favorece una relación más clara y responsable con el dinero, algo muy educativo cuando se usa con niños y adolescentes.

Entre sus puntos fuertes destacan la facilidad de uso, la visualización clara de los saldos y la posibilidad de crear grupos familiares. Además, está disponible en móvil y web, por lo que todos pueden consultar las cuentas cuando lo necesiten.

Como aspecto a tener en cuenta, la versión gratuita tiene algunas limitaciones y publicidad, aunque para un uso familiar básico suele ser suficiente.

Conclusión:
Splitwise es una herramienta práctica y eficaz para organizar gastos y deudas en familia, ideal para fomentar la responsabilidad económica y mantener las cuentas claras sin complicaciones.

honeydue|us.t: Does the job but could be a lot better.
honeydue|us.c:
(Updated 10.24.25) Still clunky as heck. No improvements based on reviews and feedback here. Dropped to one star. 

My wife and I share this app because we also share a checking account. I used a different app for many years but it didn't allow for two users to share information with one another as it was tied to one particular Apple ID. 

Enter Honeydue and the ability to have two different users share the data in real time. That part is five stars, easily. But the app lacks many basic functions of a checkbook app. 

(1) You cannot reconcile transactions. I have to add an emoji to each and every transaction entry to show that it has cleared in the bank. On top of that, I need to scroll through ALL transactions to find the uncleared ones. A simple reconciliation feature would eliminate this frustration and display those in waiting. 

(2) Transferring funds from one account to a second account involves manually entering the transaction in the primary account and then manually entering the transfer into the second account. Very clunky. 

(3) No scheduled transactions. Something as simple as a pay day needs to be manually entered every two weeks instead of being scheduled like so many other checkbook apps can do. 

(4) Transactions are scattered across the ledger. I will enter two transactions one after another for the same date and one will show toward the top of the ledger and the second will be halfway down the list for some reason. 

In all, it's an okay app but could be a lot better for these reasons. I hope to see an update soon.

honeydue|us.t: Great for keeping track of expenses
honeydue|us.c:
My husband and I use this app to track our expenses each month, and to have an overview of our different accounts in one place. Easy to use, easy to create categories. Often the transactions are sorted into the wrong category by default, but we just go into the app every few days and reassign the transactions and needed. This is easy to do via the “transactions” page. You can also split a transaction into multiple categories.

We use a spreadsheet for the actual budget/savings calculations at the beginning/end of the month, but Honeydue makes it easy to get the values needed for these calculations. 

We did have an issue where a bank wasn’t updating, but after removing the bank and adding it again, it worked just fine.

When you email support, they do not respond and you cannot delete your account or disconnect certain information. Be sure you want them to have indefinite access to your financial information before connecting accounts to this app.

But for the last 3 months, I cannot get the app to consistently show my expenses. I have tried adding and removing my accounts to get expenses to show but no success. Right now, all my expenses in the app are gone except about 10 expenses I had in October (this is now mid November). And customer service is no help.
Terrible app that does not automatically update some accounts

honeydue|us.t: Worked great until it stopped working
honeydue|us.c: I really liked this app at first but it became disconnected from my bank so that none of my spending was showing up in the app anymore. I tried reauthorizing my account but it didn't work. When I emailed Honeydue to ask for help I didn’t get any response.

There are a lot of missing transactions even when the accounts are synced. Also, when you try sorting and changing the time period, some budget categories entirely disappear, even when we know there were transactions in those categories. It’s super wack, and makes this unreliable.
If you comment on a transaction, your partner doesn’t get a notification and it doesn’t show up in the chat. Literally it’s so annoying. Glad it’s free or I would demand my money back lol

Ive been using these apps for years. And I love it. It helpful and easy to use.
I wish they have a feature where I can move all transaction to one category at the same time and for future transaction. Would live to have desktop version. I love this app!
Great app. What would make it even better? Widgets!!! 🥺🙏

Will not connect to key bank and have been trying to contact customer service for support for 30 days no response yet. Wanna know if this is going to work for us or not!! Why won’t customer support reply????

As I type this it’s a Tuesday. My account was last synced (successfully) on Saturday even though I’ve logged in each of the last two days to try to sync it. 

“We were unable to sync this account” it says. “Please check back in one day.”

This seems to be typical of the first couple of weeks I’ve tried it out. Sometimes it syncs, sometimes it doesn’t. I’m thinking of trying another app and suggest if you’re reading this that you do too.

My husband and I were really excited to get our finances all in one place, but we have 2 accounts that won’t sync and all we get are try again later error messages. I’ve emailed support twice without response and we’re close to abandoning the app altogether.
Won’t sync with my bank even though I logged in and it said it was successfully set up, support doesn’t respond.

honeydue|us.t: Won’t connect accounts and can’t get support
honeydue|us.c: No one responds when I reach out about being unable to connect accounts. They were working then stopped abruptly, so when I tried to relink they won’t now.

One of the main points of this app is keeping track of bills and getting reminders for them. I haven’t gotten a reminder for a bill in months. I just checked and all my notifications for the app are turned on. I don’t really see the point of this app anymore if it won’t even function correctly.
When I try to move an expense to a new category or mark an expense as duplicate, the action is not completed unless I do it twice.

The basic concept of the app is sound, but there are serious bugs and no one has heard from support in months.   

We love being able to work on our combined and private finances in one app, but objectively every other feature is subpar compared to most budgeting apps.  For example, it categorizes incorrectly almost every transaction.  Just looking at auto imported transactions is difficult because the title is a huge string that tells you nothing about where and on what money was spent.  To find that out you have to edit the title if the transaction, which doesn’t actually take effect until you’ve done it 2-3 times.  Then reassigning the category has to be done multiple times to take affect.

This weekend my wife spent the entire afternoon doing this process only to have all of the data revert in the evening.  She couldn’t stop crying after having wasted a rare open afternoon on nothing.  Emails to support have never been answered.

Honeydue miscategorized almost all of the expenses I needed to share with my partner. I spent more time re-doing what the app is supposed to do by default than we spend just balancing out of our separate bank accounts. So what’s the point of the app? Putting smiley faces on paid bills? Who cares about that?

I have sent several questions that have all gone unanswered for several MONTHS now.  They say in their “help” section that typical response time is 24 hours.  These questions have gone MONTHS unanswered.

There is no way to keep older transactions, nor review older transactions once you’ve gone 30 days past the transaction date that I can find.  No one is responding to requests for help.  

Unfortunate.  It had potential.

honeydue|us.t: No Ability to do Annual Budgeting
honeydue|us.c: From what I can tell after using this app for about a month, there’s no way to budget annually or see your expenses overtime.

This app would be close to perfect; however, why can’t it remember transaction categories from month to month? It is frustrating that you need to recategorize all spending every month when it clears your spending. This seems like an easy, time-saving fix. Thanks!

honeydue|us.t: Not able to link CitiBank and no customer service
honeydue|us.c: I was able to link two bank accounts but not CitiBank credit card. I emailed Honeydue twice and got no answer. It seems like they don’t include customer service at all.

Started off on the wrong foot from the get go. my wife and I each create an account only to realize that one person needs to create the account and then invite the other person. So now one of us has to delete our account so the
Other person can “invite” us to join. Talk about imbecilic app development
Very sus that you really can’t use the app unless you link your bank. There’s many apps who do this and they now have gone under and leaked info. Deleting within 5m of dl

honeydue|us.t: Doesn’t work to link major institutions
honeydue|us.c: Cannot like Betterment at all, nor Optum, nor Alight.
Bank account would sync for a week then it won’t. Emailed tech support multiple times with no response. Definitely was a waste of my time setting it up then getting no use out of it

honeydue|us.t: Finally! Why was this so hard?
honeydue|us.c: I've been looking for an app that just let's me see mine and my husband's accounts all in one place that doesn't charge a subscription. That's it. I'd gone through dozens of apps, and reached a point that I'd even pay a flat fee for it. And finally found it! And I can make custom spending categories. Will update review if anything changes but this is perfect and all I ever wanted. Plus I get to put my husband's and my face on the transactions, that's a cute touch!
It would be cool if you could add manually transaction not all banks are available

honeydue|us.t: Frustrating app that has the right features, just doesn’t always work
honeydue|us.c:
When you can connect your bank accounts, this app is great. When you can’t, it’s useless. 

I’ve now had issues with both Amex and Discover not allowing me to connect accounts or not updating when connected. They don’t seem to have a customer service dept so you can email 100 times with no response and reach out for days on messenger without response so there isn’t much that can be done when features don’t work. 

I also don’t love that you can’t export the data into sheets or excel, but the real issue is connectivity and zero app support.

I came to Honeydue after Mint closed it’s doors. At first this seemed like a perfect replacement for me, but within the first month I began to realize that certain transactions were not showing up!  I haven’t been able to discern the commonalities between them, but here’s an example. I go on our weekly shop to Walmart and Aldi. A week or so later, Walmart is on my transaction list, but not Aldi. Same day, same card. So frustrating!  Or a transaction shows up initially, then disappears!  It is maddening, and completely undermines the whole point.
Keeps losing transactions making tracking and splitting transactions impossible.

I really wanted to like this app and if it worked properly It’d be great. But I linked my bank and credit cards and the app doesn’t accurately reflect the transactions. It’s not showing any of my earnings, missing some expenses, and I found one expense showed twice even though that’s not the case in my card activity.

honeydue|us.t: Account won’t sync.  No reply from Honeydue
honeydue|us.c: Accounts have t synced in a month.  Multiple emailed have been sent to Honeydue with no reply.   Did they go out of business?
Absolutely no response to inquiries two weeks later! Guess they are finished. I’d give it lower but it’s free. Icon looks nice on my phone. Two stars.

Effective free* option to track and trend spending habits.  Gives ability to reclassify charges into editable categories with editable spending limit per category.  Use as one piece of monthly cash flow tracking for household.

*All features available on download - option to donate to app developers.

Five stars for a free app that does the job.

While this app has potential, it has a lot of kinks to workout. Transactions are often missing and I’ve received no response to either inquiry I’ve sent. Could be a good app but will find a different one that accurately captures transactions.
This app is amazing and has definitely helped my husband and I stay consistently organized with our bills, expenses, and budget!!

If you’re looking for a basic app to manually track your bills, budget out and keep your partner in the loop- then this one is honestly pretty good.
Downside is you can’t add in your expected income so you have work around it a little.

This is the perfect couples budget and expense tracker. It has just the right amount of basic features, combined with some advanced options like splitting transactions, individual vs joint accounts. Will definitely keep using!

honeydue|us.t: Has potential but execution is poor
honeydue|us.c: Some of my accounts will never sync. Transactions disappear and show up again days later. I have never received a response to any of the dozens of emails I’ve sent for support. I was excited to find this app, would have been willing to pay a little for it, but it doesn’t work well enough to trust the data. Hard to use a budgeting app that never has current data. Leads to bad decisions. If the app worked like it is supposed to with the current architecture, it would be a great app.
Please add coinbase… vanguard and merrill lynch don’t work either

honeydue|us.t: Transactions not updating; customer service nonexistent
honeydue|us.c: I loved the features of this app, but it stopped automatically pulling updates from our accounts. I’ve reached out to customer service multiple times and gotten no responses.

Looks like this app is so buggy you can’t even actually add your bank account. 
I was excited for this but the bugs in this app just seem to be too much to actually be able to use it. So unfortunate

honeydue|us.t: It was great until it wasn’t
honeydue|us.c: I downloaded this app to replace mint and was initially pleased. It even encouraged my husband to check out our finances a little more. But then my accounts stopped updating. It recommends sending an email and even gives you a link.  I’ve been emailing for almost 3 months now for and both of my banks still haven’t been refreshed. It’s impossible to budget when the accounts are that far out of date. It’s unfortunate because I really wanted this to work and thought it would.

honeydue|us.t: Good concept, but terrible bugs and customer support
honeydue|us.c: The concept of the app is really good, I wanted it to work really bad, but terrible bugs are making it unusable because transactions are not showing up properly in the app, so it’s simply not correct at all, and therefore unusable. and customer support is non existent - no one will get back to me with my issues and it’s been two weeks
I like the app overall but it’s needs more work and their customer service is Terrible. I’ve emailed them twice and it’s been over a month now and still no response.

honeydue|us.t: This app requires your bank details
honeydue|us.c: Don’t even bother downloading

I was trying to add my bank account, to which it said it was unable to be verified. So I emailed the customer service email to see if it could be resolved, and no one ever got back to me. I emailed them 4 separate times on different days using different email apps thinking that the app was the reason. I won’t be using this app if I cannot connect my bank and customer service isn’t even responding.

I have tried multiple times to connect my Discover checking/savings account, but always get the error that the “bank hasn’t been responsive.”  I emailed support at least twice and have never received a reply. Can this be fixed in an app update please? I really love the app and it would be perfect if I could actually connect my bank!!

honeydue|us.t: Broken or I’m just too dumb
honeydue|us.c: This app appears to be out of whack. The categories are not set correctly when viewing the budget, spending or transfers. Custom categories appear to not work as well. For example: credit card payments are not “Earnings” they’re expenses, but no mater where they are labeled it somehow will still show as an earning. Or maybe I’m just and idiot and am not using the app correctly. Either way, not as friendly as I had hoped it would be.

honeydue|us.t: Love the concept execution is lacking unfortunately
honeydue|us.c: The app has everything we need and I was so excited to start using it. However I can’t for the life of me get it to work as it should. I finally got everything in its place and randomly things get mixed up or the totals just stop adding up rendering the budget only semi helpful.I tried to email for help and that doesn’t even work. I would gladly pay monthly if this app could work better considering how much it could save me in the long term. It seems I’ll soon have to go elsewhere to get a fully functional budget application. So disappointed

I love honeydue, it’s a great app. I love how easy it is to use and the categories. And it’ll be going so great and then there will be bugs that show up frequently or accounts disconnect (even though I’ve given them access) and then the only way to reconnect the accounts is to reach out to honeydue and wait for them to fix the issue. Just now, everything is great and now there’s a bug that’s throwing all of the categories into one screen and it gets annoying how frequent there seems to be issues. I am constantly loving honeydue and then get a bunch of issues with the app and try to look for a different budgeting app but somehow none of them seem as good as honeydue when honeydue is working smoothly.

honeydue|us.t: Helping us get a handle on spending
honeydue|us.c:
Useful app for a couple to keep track of spending by category. 
I wish the category titles could be edited. 
Easy to link to our bank accounts.
This app is great to stay on top of your budgets. Love the simplicity and flexibility options it’s has. Highly recommend it.

One of my banks disconnected and I have been unable to reconnect. I’ve emailed support multiple times without response. I tried updating the app just now but still won’t connect. Very frustrating that customer service is so poor.

I think it’s great that they’re pioneering the system where couples are able to manage their money together. I think the software could be a lot more intuitive and do a better job with the bill tracker instead of showing all the bills that I’ve already been marked paid clearing those out-of-the-way so that you can focus on the ones that have yet to be paid.

I really wanted to like this app! It started out doing everything I needed and being so great! Now it cannot sync 2 of my accounts and cannot refresh my data. I’ve reached out to Honeydue support and received no reply. It was the perfect app for about 1 month and now the glitches make it pointless.
I keep getting an error when attempting to connect one of my bank accounts with no response from customer service after emailing twice. Recent update has not fixed the connection issue.

Tried this as a Mint Alternative and it connected to all of my bank accounts but they don’t refresh very often so you can never see all your actual transactions. Even when manually refreshing, it stays the same. Hopefully they fix it soon.

I had hoped to be able to use this with my spouse, but there are accounts that will not connect. There appears to be a lack of response from the developers, and it was somewhat concerning that there is only an app version. This was my second time trying this app once on android and now on Apple. With Mint shutting down this month, this would be the prime opportunity to move into the top free app position…

I can’t get my app to update. I’ve emailed 4x this past week and haven’t heard back even though the support says you typically hear
Back in one day. I’m super frustrated and will have to go elsewhere.

Looked promising since they’ve been receiving awards and been promoted by the App Store for a few years. I can add banks and bills but the transactions never load in so there’s literally no point to the app. It looked like exactly what we needed but if it’s broken, not so much!

honeydue|us.t: All history deleted and ZERO support
honeydue|us.c: We have been using Honeydue for the last 6 months and enjoyed many of its features.  Two weeks ago we logged to find that all our transactions were wiped out.  This is after months of categorizing transactions and managing budgets.  Have tried contacting the company several times and have had no response.  What a waste of time.
Great except I would really like custom categories. Or at the very least a groceries category and a entertainment category

honeydue|us.t: Best tool to manage Marital Funds
honeydue|us.c: I’ve been using HoneyDue since 2018. I’m getting better at budgeting with the apps help. HoneyDue is so helpful when managing my household. Especially with a spouse who overspends or when emergencies happen. It nice to have an app to organize your income and expenses!

honeydue|us.t: I really wanted to like it
honeydue|us.c:
I am a Simple Bank refugee and ever since that bank got shut down I’ve been searching for something, anything, like the budgeting system they offered within their app. Mint was a good replacement, and now that’s on the way out. So after researching a lot of articles I came across Honeydue and decided to give it a try. 

I wish I could offer an insightful review on the app design and experience. The truth is, my credit union wouldn’t connect to the app. I reached out to the support email twice and no response. So I had to give it up and close my account.
It would be amazing if the Bills section let you add your income then showed overall monthly amounts for: income, bills, leftover.

honeydue|us.t: Can’t add banks, No customer service
honeydue|us.c:
I haven’t been able to add 3 financial institutions to my account, and I have sent at least 6 emails to customer support (as directed by the app when the banks failed to connect) over the course of a month and never got a reply to a single one. Not even a “we got your message” confirmation.
I was really hoping this app would work for me, but the lack of communication is ridiculous.
Finally an app that holds both my spouse and I accountable for our spending. What a great tool!

I’ve been test driving dozens of budgeting apps lately. This app links to all of my bank accounts nicely. The user interface is intuitive, super fast, gives me the info I want to see at-a-glance, and is highly customizable. These developers nailed it. The auto-categorizing is spot on for the transactions I choose. 

The deal breaker is that I like a zero-based budget, and this app provides no way to rollover balances from one month to the next. Total deal breaker for me.  Customer support hasn’t responded to my request for this feature from 3 weeks ago, so I don’t think it’s a feature coming anytime soon. HoneyDue is almost perfect, and is probably the best choice for any couple/anyone who doesn’t care about the rollover feature.

honeydue|us.t: It’s great … when it actually works
honeydue|us.c: Used to love this app. Now it never works with connecting to your bank. I keep reconnecting the accounts and it still won’t pull data. So sad. Used to be a great app.

i was so excited about this app but sadly it’s practically useless. takes 5+ days to update so you never can tell what your actual balance is/what you’re spending. defeats the whole purpose really :( not worth it at all

honeydue|us.t: Good for observing but that’s it
honeydue|us.c:
I wish there were some kind of goals setting capabilities. I really love the interface and ability for us to see all our money together, but I can’t see all of our budget together, like the total caps. You have to go in individually which makes me still have to manually make a budget separately and then go in on the app and change the individual caps. You also can’t set it per person which would also be nice since this is couple focused.

 I also wish there was a way to set savings goals as well, obviously you can still save but we might end up switching to another app eventually due to this. 

Overall, it’s a very good tracking app but that is all. I would pay for additional features tbh and this could continue to be free.

Some articles rated this app high, not in my experience. No customer service after 10 messages to them no response , I’m canceling. No ability to add your bank if it is a credit union also you can’t see previous month’s activity. They have a long way to go!

I have had an unresponsive bank error for almost a month. I have emailed support 4 times with no response. I like the app for keeping track of bills but it would be nice if the bank connection worked and I could get a response from support.

Then my rating will go up if the issue is resolved. I’ll be looking for a new app since their support obviously doesn’t care about their customers or if their app works right. Sad.
It takes two to three days for the app to refresh my account balance which makes it hard to budget which is the exact purpose of the app. Needs to go faster.
Doesn’t connect with PNC bank. Completely unusable for us

I love love love this app! It works exactly in the way I need it. The only recommendations I have is to incorporate Zelle, and to have the ability to check off individual Split Expenses as paid instead of manually typing in the amount that was paid. Otherwise, this app is a lifesaver.

This app is one of the best finance apps I have used. It allows you to get all of your finances in order, and budget with your spouse or significant other. The best part as well as I have used this as a single person before meeting my spouse, and it is fantastic for both.
Great app so far to share with my husband.  I love that it is free, but I would be willing to pay if that helps the bugs the previous review had issues with.  So far no problems.

honeydue|us.t: Awesome app! Doesn’t sync right now.
honeydue|us.c:
Recent reviews are accurate. Husband and I really loved using it and sorting everything out the first day. It’s so convenient, fun even, and visually helpful and intuitive. 

But then it wouldn’t sync after the first two days. Items would also become misplaced after we categorized them during the times we COULD sync our banks. 

User experience was so good that we would download this again if they ever fix syncing/ categorization issues. Until then it has been deleted. Please fix this Honeydue!

I’m truly disappointed. App keeps dropping transactions left and right so you don’t have the full spending picture. Totally unreliable. Seems buggy as my credit card stopped syncing all of a sudden. My search continues after Mint has abandoned us.

The transactions from my bank are not loading. The transactions for my credit card did load.I contacted tech support and have heard nothing from they and it’s been one week. Without bank transactions loading this app is totally useless to me. If they loaded, it looks like it would be a great app.

Hi! This is favorite budgeting app! I love that it’s geared towards couples and I can update the coding to everything as needed. 

The one change I would make is within the budget section- I would have to totals not be based on absolute value. Example- 2 transfers in the same category, one that is +10 and another -10 will total to 20 rather than 0.

The app is very well made but, if you have some problems forget an answer from the customary service, they didn’t  answer at any email that me and my wife sent them. I read a lot of review where customers complain about the same problem. Don’t waist your time with this app and search for another solution.
App won’t allow me to look it over. Instead it demands my personal information before letting me look it over and decide if I want to use it
I sent a customer support ticket. Did not get any response. I really like the concept of this app but since its free I guess I can’t complain? Wish its a paid up so we can get more bug fixes.
You have to carefully compare your account with the app because not all transactions show up. The bill tracking tool is helpful.

I was so excited with the features available on this app/the real-time tracking of my accounts and expenses. However, not even two days after downloading and setting up, my bank information is not syncing to display accurate balances and I have not heard back from support on some of my accounts that were unable to sync in the first place. After reading the reviews on similar issues and seeing they are from a year ago, I’m not confident this app is worth any more of my time.
Mint is closing so I need a new budget tracker. This one on the surface does an ok job. I had so many duplicate expenses it became too cumbersome.

I always used mint before who
stopped budgeting in their new app so I moved to Honeydue. So far I like it very well. It different than mint but every day I learn more about HoneyDue which makes it more enjoyable for me. The most difficult task was getting Sam’s club to download as it’s associated with synchrony bank.

honeydue|us.t: No support and unable to invite partner
honeydue|us.c: This app has potential, but there is no customer service. I tried to link my partner’s account, but he already had one and would not allow me to link an existing user without providing another email address. We both reached out to customer support multiple time over a week ago with no response.

The good overall ratings led us to Honeydue when Mint notified us that they were ending their platform. So far though this is not meeting our needs. Honeydue does not partner with a wide range of banks. I was able to connect our credit cards, but not our savings, checking, retirement, or investment accounts. It is helpful at least to see the bulk of our everyday spending in one place, but even then the app does not update balances frequently. For several days I’ve found myself having to manually refresh each account individually. Which, to be honest, I can do just as efficiently with our card account’s apps and a pen and paper. The pen and paper method is starting to look more appealing, as at least then we would not be sharing our financial date with two separate companies - Honeydue retrieves our financial data by acting through its intermediary, Plaid.

We’re going to give it another week to see if things improve.

honeydue|us.t: Works okay for couples but has flaws
honeydue|us.c:
Now that mint is closing down, my partner and I are left scrambling to find a new app that works.

This definitely helps monitor our budget and lets us see if we’re spending too much. However, you can’t see your cashflow, which is a drawback. But we can live without it. I guess if we’re staying in budget technically you don’t need a cashflow view in theory.

Also, there is no section that tells you what bills are coming due. Luckily I have a cheat sheet to help me track due dates. But it would still help especially if you use and credit card you don’t normally use.
I was only able to connect to some of my accounts. This includes large, well known institutions like Edward Jones and a credit union that was listed as an available institution but would not connect.

honeydue|us.t: No support for Apple Savings Account?
honeydue|us.c: This app is dead in the water for us. We’ve moved our regular cash into Apple Savings for the great interest rate. If this app can’t access that, then it’s useless to us.

honeydue|us.t: Great app, but room for improvement
honeydue|us.c:
Moved over from Mint because they’re closing. Love the app, prefer it to YNAB. Love being able to share budgets and net worth with my spouse, but still be able to see my individual finances. 

Improvements needed in:
1. Setting up 2-factor authentication. Simply doesn’t work.
2. I’d love to see net worth over time.
3. Sometimes, bank accounts don’t refresh

honeydue|us.t: Couldn’t Even Link a Major Bank
honeydue|us.c:
I was hopeful as I search for a replacement for Mint. However when I tried to add a very large US bank it not only wasn’t there but the previous banks that merged to create it were. Okay, it’s an error so let’s reach out for assistance. Tapped Help and it takes me to an email. I typed it out and the send button wouldn’t accept a tap. Canceled out and tried again. Same result. 
This leaves me with no confidence in the app being able to do the basics.

I have submitted multiple support requests with zero response, not even automated response. Not sure if this is a zombie application or what. It’s a little bit buggy, need some work, and could be a really good product if anybody was paying attention.
The app does not allow to to budget without connecting to your account. You should have the option of entering your income manually.
Inability to add my bank, not receiving the texts to set up MFA, and lack of response from support makes this app unusable.

honeydue|us.t: Great product, but syncing from accounts is flawed
honeydue|us.c:
Would be a 5/5 if the app more reliably synced from our financial accounts.  Sometimes purchases don’t show up all or they do but then randomly go missing. We also need to go into the app to manually sync our accounts fairly often. 
But the product itself is exactly what I wanted to manage our household budgeting. It works perfectly for couples past the syncing issues

The concept is phenomenal. The set up is awesome but if you need Customer Service or any help in anyway sort of fashion, you can forget it. I emailed this company well over a week ago and I have yet to get even an automatic reply or help from anyone my husband and I was super excited to use his app and it is absolutely pretty much 95% useless without customer service, so I am going to see if there’s anyway I can create my own on a spreadsheet or find one similar to this because I was excited, but that balloon has burst

honeydue|us.t: Works great but cant set up a authenticator
honeydue|us.c: As the title suggest it wont let me set up my authenticator.

I downloaded this today and was really pleased by it. It’s simple and easy to use and amazing for couples. Only problem is when setting the spending limit, it won’t allow me to add a monthly limit. At the top of the screen is says “monthly limit” but no text box or way to scroll up to it. I can only adjust when it notifies me about the amount it has left. This is the main reason I wanted a budgeting app, to keep track of how much I have left to spend on non-essentials. I’ll gladly give this more stars once this is fixed, and I’ll be reaching out to developers to.

honeydue|us.t: App is no longer supported. Do not install.
honeydue|us.c: I loved this app. It was almost perfect for what we needed, but it bugged out on android and my partner couldn’t see anything. He deleted and reinstalled multiple times. We tried deleting his account and re-inviting him but only got errors. I emailed support and received no response whatsoever. DO NOT USE THIS APP.
Would give the app 5 stars if it recorded ALL of my transactions and earnings, but it is missing several. Can’t trust it. I emailed them but no response.
I’ve had issues connecting to my bank. I get an error that says to reach out to support. They have never responded. I really like the concept but it seems like there are some basic problems.

honeydue|us.t: Great App, Budget-Breaking Bug, and No Support
honeydue|us.c:
My wife and I love the budget management capabilities Honeydue offers. The app is clean, organized, and makes connecting bank accounts simple.

After we connected our accounts, we noticed some spending buckets were double what they should be. Refund transactions were counted as expense transactions even though they showed as positives in our accounts. For example, a purchase for $20 shows up correctly as -$20 in Honeydue and in our bank account. The refund for this amount shows up as -$20 in Honeydue but +$20 in our bank account. In total, Honeydue's transactions for these purchases are added up as $-40 but it should be zeroed out.

This issue wasn't tied to a single account; it was on credit cards and bank accounts. I've emailed support multiple times, submitted my queries to their chatbot, and listed my email for a response. I've received anything back from them. I thought about reaching out on their socials but they haven't been active on Twitter or LinkedIn in years.

If this one issue was fixed and support was actually a thing, I'd change this to 5 stars. Other than that, the app is great.

Even back when I first joined there were some outdated and stale websites for major banks and financial institutions that caused some account adding/syncing challenges. At first the support team was great about responding to issues and trying to resolve sync errors. But recent “updates” have removed features that would seem to be relatively critical (RIP Tip Jar and Support Chat). Even more worrying, in the last couple months the support team seems to have gone completely dark. Haven’t received any response to multiple messages to their support email, not even an auto-acknowledgement.

As a former Honeyfi/Firstly user before they shut down their consumer app, Honeydue seems to be showing similar pre-shutdown signals. Hope I’m wrong, but won’t be surprised if this app goes away within the year. Sad and frustrating given the lack of communication or explanation for these ominous changes.

honeydue|us.t: Good concept, needs bugs worked out
honeydue|us.c: I really like the idea of this app, and use it a lot (my roommate, who is also supposed to check up on it, just….doesn’t, so it’s not fulfilling its purpose there - but that’s not the app’s fault). To have all bills in one place is incredibly useful, and to be able to share it with the other wage earner is useful (even if that other wage earner never looks at it, the concept is still valid). However, there are a few issues that need to be worked out. One, when entering a new bill, when you are working in any of the fields besides name and amount (such as type and due date), the app reverts to the amount field. It’s just annoying to deal with, since you have to re-select fields a lot more than you should. Another issue is that the bill schedule is buggy. The bills are automatically selected as “monthly” in frequency when you first enter them. Personally, I think it would be a lot better to just make the space blank and require the user to select a frequency before saving, but that’s just me. Anyway, I often find that a bill I mark as “this time only” will still show up in next month’s schedule. This may be due to how again, the bill entry section always reverts to the amount field once you’ve made other selections, which is confusing and irritating, so maybe I’m missing it a few times. The reminders are not entirely customizable. You have a number of days ahead of the due date that you are allowed to choose - the due date itself, or 1, 3, 5, or 7 days. However, once you choose, you are limited to that one option. You cannot get multiple reminders for the same bill. In this ADD-ridden world, one would hope for at least a couple reminders ahead of time. Lastly, the notifications. I’m constantly having to open the app to remove a notification, and the vast majority of the time, it’s sending me a notification that I did something, such as marked a bill paid. Why am I getting notifications that I did something? I was quite aware of what I was doing at the time. I can understand getting them if my partner/roommate/spouse/etc. did something, but I really don’t need to be told that I just did something myself. Unfortunately, the app doesn’t offer the option of not receiving notifications triggered by myself. I feel like if these issues were addressed, the app would be not only useful but a lot more enjoyable and engaging to use.

Been using Honeydue for a little over two years now - SO valuable for my wife and I to manage our spending and budget. I tried all of the other apps and this one works best for us. Here’s how we use it:
- we have all of our accounts linked, including some manually added accounts (like physical cash to keep track of)
- we assign transactions to either spending or earnings, under one of the 20 categories we built out. Any cc bills or transfers between accounts are in the transfer sections. 
- here’s where we become power users (and why Honeydue is awesome): we are often netting out spending with earnings in one category, like covering dinner with friends and lumping the vemnos received in one category. Being able to do that, plus split the expense into multiple categories, is HUGE. what’s even better is editing transaction dates to match reimbursable expenses across different months. 
- once all transactions are properly accounted for, we upload the month’s data to an excel spreadsheet (since there are some limitations on history within the app, and sometimes the data gets refreshed and reorganized every 4-5 months). Not a huge deal to us, given price point and no other app doing what Honeydue can. 
-we don’t utilize the bills, activity, split expenses, or chat features

By doing it this way we are able to track spending over years as well as make sure we are getting paid back on returns, cancellations, refunds, IOUs, etc. we love Honeydue for that!

This app worked well for me for about 8 months. Then, my transactions stopped updating. I tried contacting through email and the app. Weeks later, still no response. I guess I’ll move on to another option!

I have been experiencing issues with our bank accounts not syncing with the app. Purchases and earnings do not show up in the app. I have contacted their chat feature and emailed multiple times with no response. Disappointed that this does not work as I was liking all the features

honeydue|us.t: Lots of bugs to work out
honeydue|us.c: App says it updates every day, but doesn’t pull info from my bank for multiple days. Then when it finally does update it’s missing multiple days of transactions. Customer service hasn’t reached out yet.

honeydue|us.t: What happened to this great app!?
honeydue|us.c: This app was perfect for us but the past 2 weeks there have been issues with syncing, tons of missing transactions, transactions showing up and disappearing. This is very frustrating to try to accurately track purchases. Please fix! :(
I really enjoyed using this app for my day to day expense tracker. I noticed my accounts weren’t syncing so I removed them and re-added. Now, I am not able to get my accounted inputted on the app.

Loved the app when it used to work. It was very helpful tracking our spending for my wife and I. But for about a week and a half now none of our accounts have updated. I’ve tried emailing support, and sending a Tweet to no avail.

Was excited to start using this app for our household budget between my wife and I. We built all our own categories and it worked great for a week. But our transactions stopped updating ten days ago and I haven’t heard back from support despite multiple attempts to reach out. I tried their in app help and submitted a request via email but no response and the app still hasn’t updated across five different bank accounts and credit cards. Great functions don’t help if it doesn’t update constantly.  Especially at the end of the month. I guess we’re going back to another budgeting app.

Been using this app for about a year now, and it used to be pretty clunky, but it’s getting better! I LOVE the Pull Down to Refresh option now, vs having to go into the Bank Tab, into the Account, Options, then Refresh. I only really use it for a basic overview of my husband and my finances, and it gets the job done! The only other thing I wish they would improve on is if the app could better “remember” categories. Like I get my paycheck every 2 weeks, and change it to Salary every time, but it still autos to Miscellaneous Earnings the next time it comes in. I also love the little logos they do now for the bigger companies like McDonalds and Netflix, so cute!

Edit: Everything I said still stands, but this app hasn’t updated bank balances in almost 2 weeks now, so I have no idea what our total balance is. Not good. Also I wish there was an option to Pull Down to refresh from the Balances overview page, so all your accounts will update at once.

Why won’t my app refresh? I have synced the bank accounts 3 days in a row and numbers haven’t updated. This one issue could lead to overspending to those who aren’t careful because new spending isn’t reflected in the app. Can this bug be fixed ASAP?

Absolute garbage. Yet another company looking to capitalize on personal financial information without providing an actually useful service in exchange. Can’t even get basic functionality the app promises. Unable to successfully link any accounts.

honeydue|us.t: Works okay, but uses Plaid so it’s not secure
honeydue|us.c: Mostly works, but some banks require reauthorization every week so it’s not much better than logging in yourself. Security, however, is another story: you have to disable 2 factor authentication for many banks to work, and if that’s not bad enough, Plaid (the tech used by Honeydue to connect to your accounts) sends your passwords in PLAIN TEXT. If you ever logged in with Plaid, you now need to go change every password you have used. What’s worse, Plaid just settled a lawsuit for sharing your scraped financial data with third parties!! No thank you. That’s private information, and I trusted you with it Honeydue. Not cool.

honeydue|us.t: Support NOT RESPONDING on how to track balance in Venmo
honeydue|us.c:
So I have contacted them a long while ago because I desperately wanted to try their app but my main focus is going to be my balance in my Venmo account (& Venmo card) and cash app and tracking that spending and what it goes for etc. I contacted them and heard back that I could add an account and keep track of it manually but that they were working on an actual solution and one that doesn’t actually cost me more time. TheyThey responded to that email caramel although the three suggestions they made about tracking besides adding every transaction manually didn't work.

So fast forward to a month ago, I emailed them again just to see about an update because I wanted (& still do) to be able to use their app or abandon ship.  I’m tired of getting my hopes up or wasting my time up if it’s not gonna happen.  I have emailed them two more times to get an update and not a single response about this...if it’s not going to happen then just say as such so I can start hunting again for the right app and not count on your finding a solution.

I downloaded this app very excited about the possibilities and tried to connect for different accounts and not a single one of them was possible. I have a less than common bank but I know that plaid works with it and was unable to connect. I found this app 7/12/2021, looking forward to using app.  But after 5 days still unable to connect bank.

I've tried other budgeting apps, and none worked as well as Honeydue. I especially love how seamlessly it works for couples. My husband and I are newlyweds in the process of merging some accounts, but also keeping other accounts separate. This app makes it so easy to keep track of all of that and helps us see where we are for spending and savings goals, both individually and jointly. I'm so glad I found this app and appreciate how easy it is to manage money for couples.

Came to leave a review in hopes of a company response. I’m trying to log into my local bank. I can enter my username and password and then nothing. My keyboard saids next instead of enter but that doesn’t do anything. And there’s no log in button. So for me this app is currently worthless.
Seems to validate my username/password, but right at the end of signing in, it says It couldn’t connect to the institution. Using USAA.
Overall an OK app but our TSP accounts do not update, so not very useful.

I got this app a few weeks ago after trying Honeyfi for about a year. For some reason they can’t connect to my credit card account even though I pass all the security checks and my bank says it’s sharing data. And this isn’t a podunk cc company: it’s Bank of America! I’ve reached out to support and got the same canned bot response several times in a row that it was fixed and to try again. Then totally ghosted for the past 2 weeks. What a joke. My spending is useless without my credit card. I’m still in the market for a good couples finance app but this ain’t it.

This couples budgeting app was the first app I’ve downloaded to try and keep track of our finances together. I decided on this app because I read good things about it online. But after the whole ordeal of setting up the app and trying to use it, I can honestly say, “DO *NOT* DOWNLOAD THIS APP!” The daily balances are *NEVER* up-to-date, so it makes it difficult to Really know what’s going on with your money as well as your partner’s. And if you want to transfer money from your bank into your joint account the processing time takes FOREVER. The *WORST* part of using the app was the **POOR** customer service you receive. It’s always the same person with the same response. They say they’ll have someone from their support team get back to you, but they Hardly ever do. Honestly, *DON’T WASTE YOUR TIME AND EFFORT* into trying to use this app.

Do not start with this app unless you want to enter into a life long commitment. My husband & I signed up thinking it would be helpful but it wasn’t a good match for us so we searched for how to close the account. There were directions, but once you get to the final step you will find it’s a dead end. You can’t close it as they advise you to & if you try to reach out to anyone from Honeydue for further assistance you will be relentlessly ignored.

honeydue|us.t: This is a ten star app!
honeydue|us.c:
Honeydue is excellent. It’s well thought out and lets you see where you’re spending your money, set budgets, and give you real-time looks at expenditures vs. budget for each category. You can change the category that an expenditure is in and Honeydue will learn to put that expense into that category. You can split categories for expenditures. Let’s say that you go to Walmart and get household food, then you stop at the McDonalds’s inside for lunch, and then buy gasoline there. Honeydue will let you split that bill up into as many categories as you want. This is even though your debit card or credit card only has the one entry. 

I highly recommend Honeydue for the budget-conscious.

The majority of my and my spouse’s money and investments is in Schwab. Despite this being near the top of the list of supported banks in the app, upon trying to connect, I received an error message that says “a technical change may prevent you from linking your account to Plaid-supported apps.   We are partnering with Schwab to restore your connection.” So, the app isn’t very useful to us when we can’t connect our main account. I have always used Mint, but got tired of the ads. But Mint has always been able to connect to whatever I throw at it. Guess I have to go back to Mint.

The app never updates the homepage of transactions which is the whole point of even having this app. I’ve reached out to the developers twice and even told them I was going to delete the app bc I got no resolution or follow up. Don’t waste the download. There’s way better apps out there!

honeydue|us.t: Refuse to add option to change week start.
honeydue|us.c: It would be an amazing app if they would just add the ability to change the week start /end from Sunday to Saturday to something custom. Most people get paid on Friday. I pay my bills weekly on Friday. Other people get paid on other days. I can’t use this app to see what’s due from Friday thru Thursday. I’ve sent multiple requests to the devs for this feature. They get ignored. It’s not a big ask, it makes sense. Therefore, I won’t be using this app until they make that change. I check in periodically to see if they added that feature but it’s been a year and no luck. My spreadsheet works better. So, 2 stars because it’s useless to me as a financial app, and poor developer response.

Maybe they switched focus over to the Honeydue Checking and lost support for the App

I haven't been using the app recently (thank you, COVID-19, for making my accounting incredibly simple and overwhelmingly depressing…)

After performing a required update, I wasn't surprised that 5 of my accounts had been paused. I was disappointed that my recently closed account had no historical data. I was surprised when I couldn't connect my new account with the same financial institution. Finally I was confused when the one account that I did connect, mysteriously disconnected two hours later. (My bank emailed me to make sure it was me that closed the connection, so it probably wasn't my bank.)

I also noticed duplicate entries for a number of transactions on the one account I did connect. 

I love the Budget pie chart and wish I could upload my data to it.

I have problems connecting accounts to the service probably once every couple of months. Recently the help desk has stopped responding to my request entirely, making this app totally useless as I can no longer connect my accounts. What’s the freaking point of this app if you can’t connect accounts properly!!!

What a clunky app!! Can’t even get past the first screen. Won’t let me input an email without throwing an error code. You would think that someone would notice they are not getting any new customers. Shows the lack of attention to basic details. I guess I’ll go elsewhere. ✌️out!

I haven’t been able to use the app yet since it is not compatible with my credit union. However, this review is just an alert to others considering downloading it: read through the reviews carefully! Some “5 star” reviews clearly call out problems with the app and I just read one that CLEARLY said they wished they could give a 5 star review, went on to list multiple issues and yet somehow still shows up as a 5 star review (no “update to original review” praising a fix or solution). If the app ever works for me and is worthy of better review, I will be sure to update. For the time being this review is 1-star!!

honeydue|us.t: Bummer.  Would be great if it worked properly...

Very challenging to set up accounts because there are lots of missing institutions (i.e. Ally Auto, carious Comenity bank connected accounts or my bank’s business login portal) and several other accounts do not work (including Betterment and Freedom Mortgage) even when using the proper login credentials.  There is no use for this app unless one can log into every account.  Customer service has tried to help, but no solutions yet.  I am disappointed because it seems like it could be useful.

honeydue|us.t: Easy to use but still flexible
honeydue|us.c:
I’ve just been using this app for a week so this is all preliminary. It’s really easy to use out of the box and has all the views I want to see built in, but also has flexibility with categories and what  to include and exclude. The separate views for me and my wife are also great since we are looking at different aspects of our budget. 

Only downside is that linking to less important accounts, like my mortgage, has been challenging. But these links are just a nice-to-have.
Even though this app isn’t supported in my region the UI/UX for manual entry and management of our household finance was awesome!!! Thank you!!

honeydue|us.t: My credit card isn’t an option
honeydue|us.c: I like the app so far except that I can’t add my apple credit card. The card isn’t one of the options so I can’t connect it. Hopefully it can be added soon!

My husband and I use this to track all our accounts and budgets. We’ve tried a few different apps and found all lacking. But this one is excellent and has incredibly responsive customer service. Can’t recommend highly enough!

We’re loving the app! Another feature we would LOVE is a “sinking funds” feature. 

Without opening up another account, it would be great to be able to categorize the balance within and across savings accounts and designate them to certain savings goals, such as a home down payment or a Christmas fund, and add to the funds over time as our savings balance increases. 

PLEASE PLEASE add this feature! It will help make it possible for us to continue using the app long-term!

I am a financial coach and this feature would make HoneyDue my #1 app recommendation!

I emailed support and was told they’d pass it along and get back to me. They didn’t. I followed up three weeks later, and again about two months after that, and haven’t heard anything at all. Doesn’t feel good to know they’re not interested in user feedback. We will continue to use because of the great reliability, but we’re looking around for an app that can meet our all our needs.

honeydue|us.t: So frustrated, customer support never responds
honeydue|us.c: This app is bad and so is the customer support. I do not recommend this app. It has trouble connecting with many accounts. I had contacted customer support and got a reply once. I followed up 6 weeks later, no response. I followed up again another 6 weeks later. Again no response. honeydue|us.t: Perfect for couples budgeting with multiple accounts

Being able to set a default split amount (other than the default 50%) would also be helpful.

This would be our preferred budget app if it kept more than 6 months of data. I keep checking in hoping it will allow us to see a medium or long term view of our budget, but so far that isn’t an option. I would gladly buy a one time addition to the app that allowed for a longer duration of transactions to be kept (I don’t do subscriptions). For now I’m still using that app occasionally, but we had to move our primary focus for budgeting somewhere else. I just lost all of the data from January because I didn’t screenshot it in time (it was gone July 1st). No one should be keeping such a limited view of their budget. Moving the data to being stored on devices or allowing people to choose where their data is kept would also be nice. I’m a little uncomfortable with our data being stored on remote servers when I can very easily store it on my phone and back it up from there.

honeydue|us.t: Okay but could be much better
honeydue|us.c:
I’ve been using Honeydue for over a year now. The concept is great....the execution is okay.

One of the major pain points is that your bank accounts don’t update in real time, so you don’t really have an accurate view of your finances at any given point. The other is that your banks often disconnect. When this happens, support will always tell you they’ll switch you to a more stable data aggregator, but it doesn’t always work and some of these integrations seem unstable.

Lastly, the user experience could greatly be improved. I’ve gotten use to navigating around all the noise, but it seems like more efforts and resources should be dedicated to make sure the core product works correctly, rather than push out half baked ideas like the activity feed, bill splitter, or Visa card. I would happily pay for the app if it was more reliable.

This app has been a lifesaver for us! I’m super into budgeting but my husband.... is not. This app lets us both set up our accounts separately but only one of us (hehe me) has to categorize the transactions into our shared budget. It’s a great tool for couples that share a budget but keep separate bank accounts and credit cards. It’s also free! What is not to love? We don’t use their visa or money sharing tools as we transfer directly from bank to bank when needed, so not sure about that functionality, but it can do that as well. The customer service is excellent. I’ve asked a few questions and they are always helpful and responsive.

This app is on the verge of greatness! I have three requirements for a budget app, and so far this one is the closest:
I want to be able to share with my partner ✔️
I want to track spending ✔️
I want to have goals for savings ✖️
I’d really like to be able to tell the app that the money in this account is money I’m saving towards X goal, and have partner also be able to contribute to those savings goals.

Additionally, none of my banks work very well with Honeydue. Either they can’t be connected at all, or if they can, I need to log in again whenever I want them to sync, which is too much of a pain to bother with. I’ve already emailed support about this quite a bit, and they’ve been semi-helpful, but overall I’m still having these problems.

The whole point of getting this app was so my husband’s spending was showing since he always forgets to tell me when he’s purchased something. The app doesn’t update the balance consistently enough to keep track of what’s actually being charged. It also doesn’t show the actual available balance in the main balance screen. Deleting and looking for something else.
None of my data loads. Displays network error, although apps on device have no issues.
Last update is now causing app to crash every time it is launched.  Please fix.

Latest updated causes my app to not open. Tried to send support, but it attempts to open the app.

I love this app, works well for what we need. Will definitely update this rating if a hot fix can be made so I can get in!
Love this app but your new update today immediately crashes on my iPhone XS running iOS 13.5. Please fix!!! I’ve restarted my phone several times but it still crashes every time.

I first contacted support on May 3rd and again on May 16 because I didn’t not receive my debit card. I am contacting support again because the funds that I currently can not access were meant to be used for our deposit to move to an apartment. I need access to those funds by the end of this week to pay the deposit for our move. I need someone to contact me and assist me in getting the card to access the funds or how to access the funds otherwise. I am trying to secure housing for my partner and I during these tumultuous times. Please advise.
Create an IPad version please

Nice to see all of our accounts in one spot.  I’d like to be able to exclude some accounts from the budget (for example, credit card transactions show up multiple times - once when you charge something then again when you pay).  Would also be nice to see a running total of an account with all bills upcoming.

Former YNAB 4 and YNAB cloud user. (Still currently use YNAB excel spreadsheet monthly).

Due to the subscription cost of YNAB now and unable to continue to use YNAB 4 and associated YNAB classic iOS app, I needed a system to keep up with the household budget and spending between me and my spouse.

We’ve been using Honeydue for the past two months combined with an old YNAB excel spreadsheet. Keeping high level categories in Honeydue along with manual expense tracking accounts for Groceries, etc reconciled with YNAB spreadsheet at month end has been a great alternative.

I still have my sense of control over the budget to ensure every dollar is assigned and at work, as well as my spouse not only seeing the high level roll up, but being able to see our overall picture in our other financial accounts.

Honeydue has been a wonderful experience thus far. 

We are also looking forward to being able to use the joint checking account in the future once some of the “upcoming” features are released and limits are adjusted.

I will tell you my whole experience with HoneyDue, and it’s really up to you to sign up after. 
My partner and I downloaded the app and created our accounts because we thought it was going to be beneficial to have a joint account since we were going to move in together. The whole signing process went smoothly. 
* TRANSFERRING MONEY IN: 
It takes 4-5 days for money to clear and be available once you transfer. 

* NO TRANSFERRING MONEY OUT:
There’s no way possible for you to transfer money out of this account, to another one. 

* NO ATM FREE OF CHARGES: 
You won’t be able to withdraw money from any ATM without facing at least $3.00 fee or $5.00, depending. 

* LIMIT AMOUNT TO WITHDRAW PER DAY: 
You won’t be able to withdraw more than $250.00 per day per account. Meaning, that you would only be able to access to $500 maximum if you withdraw $250 on each account. 

*LIMIT AMOUNT TO WITHDRAW PER MONTH: 
You won’t be able to withdraw more than $1,200 per month. 

*HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE: 
When you call over the phone, the customer service you receive is really HOPELESS. You will wait forever on the phone and won’t get any response. 

After this whole experience, There’s really no point to get this app rather than going to a full credited bank.

My wife and I would love to try this app for its features as we are looking to move on from our old bank but we can’t even get the simple act of creating a joint account to work. I have an account that I send an invite to my wife from, she receives the invite name proceeds to create an account so we can be linked. It then proceeds to tell her the pin code she received seconds earlier is invalid. Every time. We’ve tried cancelling the invite and resending to a different email address. Same thing. We’ve tried texting the invite. Same thing. So we are stuck not being able to even get her into the app. I can understand certain glitches and quirks that an app may have but when that glitch is a barrier to entry it’s extremely frustrating. Hope it gets fixed so we can actually try out the app.

honeydue|us.t: Honeydue is what you thought Mint would be
honeydue|us.c: Honeydue is the best finance tracking app I’ve seen yet. It is perfect for my situation because I share finances with my partner, but it also has the common sense features other finance apps lack. I love how easy it is to add cash purchases, split single purchases into multiple budget categories, and remove “purchases” that are actually just me moving money around. Honeydue is the only app I’ve ever used that actually gives me a clear overview of my finances, and it definitely performs its core mission of helping me and my partner split purchases.
I date some of my month end expenses to the next month due to timing of when I get paid. The new update added a filter to my expenses which makes it so I can’t see my expenses dates into the future.
Just tried this on my iPad but now my next is killing me! Why can’t it switch when I have it on my keypad (landscape)?

The idea of this app was intriguing. My spouse and I have our own bank accounts, but we always openly share how much money we have, what bills to pay, etc. this simplified it a little bit. It doesn’t seem to update balances very often so usually I would be seeing a balance that was from the day before. We decided to give that Honeydue Visa card a try. The cards came in the mail. I decided to deposit a small amount of money into the joint account just to see the time it took. We are almost to day 6 and the money still hasn’t cleared. It cleared the funding account quickly of course. They blamed it on the holiday...which was day 4. My bank clears money the next day, weekday or weekend. My paycheck clears almost as soon as HR posts them. The time it’s taking Honeydue to clear money that they’ve had for days is a huge turn off and I don’t foresee using this joint account anymore. I can’t imagine how long it would take if I moved my direct deposit to this account. I would be waiting a week for my paycheck. If the bank transfer is going to take this long then there should at least be an option to use a debit card to fund the account without the huge wait.

honeydue|us.t: Love the app! Don’t love the format..
honeydue|us.c:
The app is amazing. I’ve used a couple so far, but this one blows them out of the water. Functionally, almost flawless. 

Visually, the app is a little annoying to navigate. The news feed section on the first page isn’t necessary and the general layout is too complicated. If the app were simplified, it could be a lot easier to use.
Like the app and functionality but consistently experience issues with capital one credit cards syncing. Hopefully something you guys can address so we can keep using the app.

honeydue|us.t: Well designed and exactly what we needed!!
honeydue|us.c: Before we started using this app, my fiancée and I didn’t have a good way to split our expenses. We would try to alternate who bought groceries (sometimes they cost $20 sometimes over $100). One would take care of the phone bill, another would do power and gas. It was awkward reminding your partner to pay if they forgot. With this app, you can go through your bank transactions and mark the ones that need to be split. You can split them evenly or just share a portion of the cost. You can even add expenses manually Incase you paid by cash. I love this app. And it’s FREE!! I loved everything about this app until I realized that it was NOT calculating the final figure correctly. If two people take a trip and person A pays $100 and person B pays $50, the app says person B owes person A $50. That is not correct. Once the balance of $50 is paid, person A has paid $50 and person B has paid $100. The app should be taking $100-$50=$50.00 and dividing that total in half. Half of $50 is $25. That is what person B owes. Now both parties have paid $75. The app is doing the math wrong and one of the parties is getting screwed. Please fix it, so it can be worthy of the 5 stars people are giving it. It gets more complicated when you add more people. Please

tricount|us.t: The app does not do the one thing it needed to do, split costs between more people.

So from the first try, it calculates all wrong. I entered 8 people going on a trip with 2 cars. Person “A” pays for the insurances for all 8 people and person “B” pays for the gasoline but only for selected 4 people. 

The person “C” needs to only pay the person “A” for the insurance…..but the app calculates that the person “C” needs to pay the person “A” for the gasoline even if he is not added to the group, and on the other hand shows that the person “C” only needs to pay for insurance some small amount that is not realistic to the person “A”

So already by adding first 2 expenses, the app totally miscalculates everything. 

Imagine if you rely only on this app  to distribute costs, and you do not control al of it at the end….it will totally miss calculate everything and all participants will get random and uncorrect values.

I just started using Tricount for managing expenses on group trips.  I really like the interface and the app seems to work well.  It has most of the basic features that I need, but I hope to see a few enhancements: 

- the ability to type the shares in (for share-based expense allocation); hitting the + button 30 times is tedious
- the ability to set default allocations for each expense category type in each Tricount
- the ability to see a summary of total expenses allocated to each member, and the total already paid by each member; presently even the group admin can only see their own expenses (“my expenses”) or a summary of balances, but I would like to be able to see a summary of all members’ total expenses and total amount already paid.
- a web-based interface to manage Tricounts on a PC (in addition to the phone app)

The new app retains the capability to tag your expenses in a certain category, but there’s no way to filter transactions based on it.

The previous version of the app (pre-redesign) allows that, please bring it back otherwise it’s a redundant feature.

tricount|br.t: Enhancements for Recurring, Installment-Based, and Monthly Expense Management
tricount|br.c:
The app looks great and works properly. However, I see a very important improvement opportunity: the website indicates the existence of recurring expenses, but in practice this feature is not available in the app. It would be essential to support both recurring expenses—such as rent—and installment-based expenses, for example a travel package purchased in six installments, allowing the total amount to be automatically split and recorded across the following months.

In addition, the front end currently shows only the total expenses. It would be valuable to have the option to view expenses by a specific month, compare different months, and allow a monthly, adjustable split of expenses among participants.

La aplicación Tricount siempre me ha parecido un referente en accesibilidad, especialmente para quienes utilizamos VoiceOver en iPhone. Por eso me ha sorprendido que, tras las dos últimas actualizaciones, varios elementos importantes hayan dejado de ser accesibles.

En concreto, los botones “Nuevo Tricount” y “Añadir gasto” no son correctamente reconocidos por VoiceOver, lo que dificulta realizar acciones básicas dentro de la aplicación.

Es una pena porque Tricount ha destacado durante años por ofrecer una experiencia muy cuidada para todos los usuarios, incluidos aquellos con discapacidad visual. Espero que este problema pueda corregirse en una próxima actualización para que la aplicación vuelva a alcanzar el excelente nivel de accesibilidad que siempre ha tenido.

Por supuesto, mi amiga denunciada, y para colmo, sin comer. Recomiendo descargar esta aplicación si no quieres hablar con alguien más.

tricount|es.t: Select All and Unselect All button | Gastos Detallados
tricount|es.c:
Hola, la version nueva esta buena en lo que respecta a diseño y demás, pero ha perdido algunas cosas que eran muy util de la anterior. Como las siguientes:
- Al subir un gasto automáticamente estan seleccionados todos los participantes del grupo y la nueva version no tiene un botón para tildar y que no se seleccionen todos. Seria muy bueno que se incorpore nuevamente el checkbox de Select All o Unselect All. 
- Personal mode: ya no se encuentra mas la opción de seleccionar “personal mode”. En la cual podia elegir para que te muestren solamente los gastos en los cuales estabas afectado y tambien la opción de mostrarte un detalle en la linea de cada gasto que parte de él impactaba en tu balance. Era un opción muy util para poder tener visibilidad mas facil de que gastos te afectaban y sin la necesidad de ir gasto por gasto viendo cual es el importe que te impacta en tu balance personal. 
Ojalá que puedan volver a agregar estas dos cosas. Uso mucho Tricount en mi vida diaria, y creo que la ausencia de estas dos opciones afectan notablemente la experiencia del usuario. 
Saludos
