tricount|es.t: Decepción tras pagar la suscripción premium
tricount|es.c:
Actualmente, la aplicación es gratuita, pero me gustaría que me devolvieran la parte proporcional del dinero que pagué por la suscripción premium anual. Pagué esta suscripción principalmente para poder descargar mis gastos en formato CSV, y ahora esa opción no está disponible ni siquiera en la versión gratuita. Me siento defraudado, ya que pagué específicamente por esa funcionalidad.

Además, han eliminado varias características útiles que solía usar. Antes podía cambiar la vista de gastos para ver solo los que me afectaban a mí y ver el saldo después de cada gasto. Ahora no es posible, ya que los gastos siempre se muestran de la misma manera. Tampoco se puede introducir una descripción en el Tricount creado.

La aplicación tiene un diseño bonito, pero no la elegí por su apariencia. De hecho, había otras aplicaciones más atractivas visualmente en el mercado. La seleccioné porque era la más útil y cubría mejor mis necesidades. La eliminación de la opción online ya fue un gran inconveniente, pero aún así decidí continuar y pagar la suscripción premium para poder descargar mis gastos en CSV.

Desde entonces, he visto cómo la aplicación ha perdido funcionalidad progresivamente, mientras que se han añadido características como la tarjeta, que puede ser útil para algunos, pero no para mí. En resumen, la aplicación ha dejado de ser diferenciadora y se ha convertido en una más entre tantas otras en el mercado, sin aportar nada nuevo ni especial.

Antigua usuaria premium, ahora eso ya no existe y no devuelven el dinero a pesar de que te cobraban por un año.

La aplicación ahora es distinta menos funcionalidades y con la idea de endosarte una tarjeta de crédito.

This is absolutely one of the best if not the best splitting app available. 

First- the most common activity on this kind of app is adding an expense on the go, so you want it to be quick and painless. Settle up by far has the fastest expense adding framework, because you can start by tapping the name of the person who paid. Seems like a small thing, but it makes a big difference in the field. 

Second- exporting transactions is not behind a paywall. 

Third- unlimited transactions not behind paywall. 

Fourth- default shares for groups and an advanced expense adding experience for things like meals where tax and tip might be separate from the item subtotal. This includes a calculator in the subtotal area as well. 

Overall- the app looks a little dated. But who cares. All the basic functionality is there, it’s the fastest to add an expense, and only appropriate functionality is behind the paywall (like categories, receipt storage, and recurring transactions).

settleup|us.t: Great app, very intuitive and well thought through. But
settleup|us.c:
This is the best app for splitting expenses I found. It has a very slick interface, all required details are easily available and accessible. 

I wish it had 3 relatively small features that I proposed to the authors that could be implemented (had no negative or positive response from the authors so far).

Ability to assign a fixed amount to a person(s) and exclude them from further sharing. Use case: a participant bought something completely different and their prices are fixed regarding the rest of the spending
Ability to assign adjustments for sharing. Use case: in a restaurant, the entire bill is split evenly but one person ordered an expensive drink for himself and wants to exclude this amount from sharing, or a person didn’t order an expensive dessert and its share should be reduced by this amount
Ability to create a paying group which is very natural in multi-family events (especially with children who could be accounted for differently). All calculations are as is but in the end, group spending and debts are combined. It makes regular accounting simple. No multipliers, all other accounting as described in 1) and 2) are still applicable on the individual level but the final settlement is natural
The nice thing is that all these features could be introduced in a way that the old interface would work the same way without additional complexity for those who are not interested yet accommodating more complex use cases. 

I hope developers would listen to this proposals, it doesn’t look too complex and should not change the existing API too much

settleup|us.t: Fantastic travel companion for group expenses
settleup|us.c: I absolutely love this app. Been traveling with friends for years, and this one has been the absolute best. It allows weighted contributions for people… for example, a married couple can have an assigned value of 2, and single people can have a value of 1. Making it so an even split bill (such as a taxi or hotel) will automatically split appropriately. If you’re traveling through multiple countries with multiple currencies, it will accurately convert the consolidated debts of each person in a group. We used to spend hours obsessing over who owes what at the end of a trip, but it’s not an issue anymore. It’s worth purchasing premium for the group (one time cost, benefits all transactions within the group). Groups can be reset after a trip is complete, which means you can continue having the perks of premium for a future trip at no extra cost.

settleup|us.c: The interface take some getting used to but you soon realize it was well thought out. Very valuable.

Good app when using between similar platform phones (iPhones/droids etc) but when trying to sync between an apple and a droid or google phone - not all of the payments or debts settled show up. Very frustrating.

Great app for tracking expenses! Used it from groups of 2-17 to track vacation expenses. Truly excellent, and with nice visuals to help you figure out who should pay next for things.

Improvements could be making it easier to make revisions (particularly concerning amounts to previously-documented payments. But otherwise, great!

Wow. Nice. We split the cost of lunch at work all the time. Whether we split the bill evenly or someone gets something extra, the app handles it well. The interface is easy to use and nice looking. I tried free apps that forced you to create online accounts. This one doesn't, and works much better.

I want to like this app so much. The idea is great and the features sound really useful, but it's so inconsistent that it's basically useless. Only 1 time out of 50 does it actually sync (the rest of the time, it just says I have an Internet connection error, but I'm still able to sync with the old version of the app, so it's clearly not on my end). If I'm not able to share the group with others, there's not much point in using it, so this is probably the end for me and settle up.
When I go to look at snapshots of someone else's receipts, it says "no snapshot." What gives?! Otherwise, useful app, if expensive for an app with a bug like that.

for an app that actually costs money, this is horribly designed, completely unintuitive. for instance, when you click on a person’s name, you expect to see all the things he/she paid for, but no, it takes you to the “adding a debt” menu, yet there’s a huge dedicated “+” sign serving just that purpose. Also, there are no integration with payment apps like paypal or venmo, so when you click on “settle debt” there are no way of actually settling the debt. 

there are free apps that does exactly this with much more elegance, splitwise for instance. unless they revamp the UI, i don’t see any reason why anyone should pay for THIS.

An existing group can be unstable. Had several cases where one or two costs don't get shared across the group - meaning members all see different balances (all show as synced however). Now some groups say sharing is off for an e-mail address. Very buggy for an app that charges a fee. I would recommend looking at other similar apps, there has to be something more reliable than this one.

settleup|us.t: Keyboard doesn't pop up in ios 8
settleup|us.c: Can't enter descriptions

settleup|us.t: Awesome app - but small but on iOS8

Not as intuitive and missing features the old version has like calculator and splitting non evenly between people.

tandem|us.c: The app has you make an account and takes you to a paywall you can’t get passed. This app seemed great by the ads but you can’t even try it out without buying first?

tandem|us.t: Started Off Good, Then Not Working
tandem|us.c: I created a shared transaction, then once account was set up, no clear way to create anymore split transactions. Navigation and onboarding doesn’t seem thought out
It has you sign up but then doesn’t let you delete the account when you don’t want to pay for it.

Used this app religiously with my wife and now bugs stop our progress. Need to add new accounts now and the app doesn’t let me. Trying to look for alternatives. Good in practice but this app doesn’t have a professional team behind it.

Even i wanted to use this app the amount of in app purchases when FIRST downloading genuinely takes over. At least let your downloaders get a chance to use it a lil because it’s common sense that a 7 day trial wont work for a relationship thats ACTUALLY trying to build something. If the app changes this issue, Id have no problem using it but mentally who wants a app that only throw’s subscriptions at you when you first download it. I would actually like to speak with the CEO on why a longer trail wasn’t given.

In general, love the app and the way it works but it is very very buggy - and things that used to work, don’t anymore. I cannot unlock repeating splits, it mixes pending and non-pending charges for the same items (and you may need to unsplit pending auto splits). CC Credits used to show, but not any more. not easy to trace a charge back to an account, the labels applied to charges are sometimes changed / erroneously wrong. Wish there was a mode that listed it exactly matching the CC. Support is fairly unresponsive now - we’re great at the beginning.

My now husband and I have used this app for the 5 years we were dating. It’s been a staple and helps keep track of what we pay for especially when it came to trips. I love the app and how easy it is to use.

Transactions does not show which card was used. Impossible to split items like Amazon orders where we use multiple cards. And everyone I move away from the Transaction tab (clicking on another tab, or briefly switching to another app like my bank), the page refreshes and I lose where I was at.
It’s been months since I wrote my original review and the issues never were resolved. Don’t recommend.
Don’t have any transactions to split so I guess I’m not allowed to use this app

Such a great app for splitting cost but it seems like the developer has decided to park this project… bugs not getting fixed, no support team at all. I hope someone would take over this app and make it great again…
Can’t get past the password creation

Update: it’s been 4 months and I still haven’t been able to resolve any support issues, can’t get ANY response. Last patch was 7 months ago, clearly the creator of this app has abandoned it. 

Tried using this app for over a month but it would never connect my account to my partners. We reached out to support several times, tried to call someone. Nothing. I can see my partner but they can’t see me constant 404 errors when trying to link. Horrible experience. Will be charging back the subscription fees.
Great way to keep up with expenses. Being able to do recurring, split halfway or at a certain percentage is very helpful

Reached out to support 4 times and no response. We even paid for the subscription. Save your money, I’ll be disputing with my credit card to get my money back since service is not responsive.

This app has been great for myself and my fiance over the last few years living together.  Lately though, we’ve noticed repeating split transactions that we’ve set up not actually repeating, and we’ve been unable to modify them after the fact for future terms, just turn them on and off.  Additionally, I was recently randomly signed out of my account and when I requested a password reset, no email with a link was sent.  After this failing multiple times, I attempted to contact support via the chat feature, also with no response.  I finally decided to create a new email account, and reconnect with my fiance.  We still aren’t seeing our transactions together and the app appears to not be supported.  We’ve loved this app’s features so much these last years, but the lack of support is crippling!

This app is great in theory, but it doesn’t function at all. My partner and I both have issues logging in, making the accounts, and joining accounts. Their automated response help tool doesn’t respond. I think the app is unmanaged and needs to be taken down.
only a 3 day free trial?? at least offer a week, cheapskates. and no notice of cost of the app until after you make the account and type all your info
wish they told you anywhere it’s a monthly subscription to even make an account, didn’t even get to see what the app had to offer without it forcing me to pay
This is the perfect app for my partner and I however it kept bugging making it nearly useless. If you reach out for support they don’t respond back.

Hi, so I truly enjoy the idea of this application. It’s living made simpler for those who live together. However, the app has so many glitches and it honestly needs to be reset completely. It doesn’t let you delete or add stuff and it stays giving you errors. Please make this app better thanks.

tandem|us.t: Great but needs some more features
tandem|us.c: This app would be perfect if it had a way to plan future bills like be able to customize the date under Manual entry for example I want to add my electric bill so when it comes I would like to be able to go into manual entry and type in the amount and set the day that it’s do so my partner can have a heads up on upcoming bills instead of me having to pay with my card and then wait for him to pay me back when he can plan to get the money to me before the bill is due.

This app was great for a while for my boyfriend and I to split expenses. But then I started having issues with my connected bank accounts where they’re duplicated and I can’t delete them. Every time I try I get an error. It’s now been over a month and I’ve sent multiple messages to their support team through the app and have yet to receive any response. I’m so disappointed. Have been reaching out for days for help with customer service. There is no customization within the app for settling up custom amounts.

Reached out because kept having issues with app resetting when payments would be due. Reached out THREE times, never heard back from anyone through the app. Impossible to get in touch with. Waste of money.
I absolutely love this app and it is worth its weight in gold. Helps so much with splitting expenses. Only feature I think it needs is a weekly meal planner. Include that and it would be perfect!

Reached out to customer service regarding my membership in October 2024, followed up in December 2024 and again in March 2025. No response. What’s the point of having a customer support chat if no one monitors it or responds? I would like a refund.
I tried to create an account. The app is stuck asking for 11 dollars and suggesting I choose 14.   No response to anything.

I’ve had the app downloaded for two years now and have just been waiting for an android version to become available. I feel stuck in our finances since we aren’t married and do not have a joint bank account. I’m begging you guys to please please please make an android version!
What am I paying for? I can’t login half the time. I get an error message saying there was an issue signing me in and to try again later.

The overall idea of what features and flows WOULD be useful is generally sound, yet execution and actual functionality were somehow botched. It’s half of the idea (at best) in action. I don’t believe that user flows or journey maps were carefully considered, leading to a very clunky and frustrating experience. I really wanted this to be a convenient way to track expenses with my partner, but is actually a headache in practice.

Inexplicably, my credit card transactions won’t load for months. Then when I message customer support, there’s 0 support. Not even a response after sending multiple messages requesting help. Transitioning to an app with better support for paying customers. Pathetic. (I would hate to be the VC who backed this team)

tandem|us.t: Should be perfect but it’s not
tandem|us.c: For $13/month I’d expect this app to work perfectly... I cannot edit reoccurring transactions - and yes I see WHERE to do it, the app just keeps crashing when I try to do so. You also cannot edit payment history once it’s done so better not make any mistakes.
Need to make more categories in order to track, or an easier way to add a category

App wasn’t that useful. The fact it requires a subscription is appalling. Maybe have a free version and a paid version that offers more features but even with the subscription the app does not offer much. Other apps have similar features. Look elsewhere for a free app.

My fiancée and I just started using this and it’s been so helpful to not only track and split expenses, but also figure out who should pay to help keep our expenses split properly!

My only feature request would be to add a manual expense button in the transactions tab. I use a card that isn’t supported by Plaid and the manual expense is kind of hidden in the split expense on the home screen.

Zero chance you’re getting $28 a month from us. Make a free version with Pro options and prove that this is essential to a relationship. 3 days is barely enough to figure out the app and start using it, nevermind convincing 2 people to use it and have it be ubiquitous to a relationship.

I LOVE this app. I haven’t found any others that have all the same features. However they desperately need a version for Android. I recall seeing something over a year ago that it was being worked on but nothing yet. My husband has an Android and that makes things more difficult. Otherwise would be a 5-star app.

It grabs ALL your information BEFORE telling you that you’re going to be made to pay for the app if you want to use it at all. All while being advertised as free of course cause who doesn’t love a good bait and switch.
Was really interested in trying this app but we are a split Apple/Android household. Could not find the app for Android and your website only gave the option to download from the Apple App Store.

tandem|us.t: Have to pay to even use it
tandem|us.c: I really needed something to try to get money saved with my Fiancé and I thought this would’ve been amazing based on the ads I saw. I download and boom! You can’t even use the app without AT LEAST paying $10 (Ten Dollars USD)!!! If people needed this service truly, they possibly wouldn’t have the financial wiggle room for the monthly subscription!

I wish you had a free version! Was excited to try the product but couldn’t make it past the monthly charge. I get added features can cost $, but wish there was a free version for couples who are saving money, which was the main purpose of me downloading the app.
I like the app, would like it a lot more if we could create our own categories. Thanks
The concept of this app is wonderful. But it’s slow to use, often duplicates transactions, crashes, frequently requires relinking your accounts. And it seems to not be getting improved
I was just trying to do the free trial and got charged for the year. This was in September and they still have not returned any of my messages

I like the idea of the app in general, but seriously, a “pay what you think is fair” tab that I cannot close without actually knowing what I’m doing in the app? Like I couldn’t just look through the app to even see if it would actually work for the needs? I think it’s silly as well because while some people are generous and will pay more, there isn’t anything telling me what I’m paying for! I’m not going to agree to pay for something without knowing how it works.

This has to be the dumbest thing I’ve ever seen the app on the App Store listed it for free but that is completely false you have to pay to use the app otherwise your stuck on a screen that says “get started with a free trial” why list the app as free if in order to use the content of the app you have to pay?!?!?!

tandem|us.t: Customer Support is nonexistent; ok concept for new couples/divorced parents
tandem|us.c: I was influenced to download this app because of the concept of being able to split expenses easier than using payment apps. Upon launching the app, I could not bypass anything without purchasing first. Since I had been promised an app that would make splitting expenses easier I decided spending the $60 was worth it. However, I quickly realized that it is hardly any different from splitting costs through payment apps such as cash app. I like that I can see my own expenses, but I would have to manually add the person I want to split with, designate the amount, and then still use a payment app to split it anyways. The only thing that is interesting that I could maybe use is shared to do lists and wishlists…but I can do that for free in my notes tab in my phone. Overall, this might be good for new couples or divorced parents that prefer to split all costs down to the dime or those who don’t trust each other financially (I.e. instead of saying dinner costed $50 the app has the specific charge down to the dime)…but it won’t be beneficial to me as someone who needs to move large sums back and forth for rent and other expenses. Why my review is so low: Since I have no need for it and haven’t used the service once—I contacted support within several days of my purchase and requested a refund. I never heard anything back. I wasted $60 for absolutely nothing—especially since I’ve never used the function at all. Really disappointed but mostly by the lack of response. Further, the cost of the app is overall just way too high, especially when apps like Rocket Money exist that offer many of the same features for free.
No one responds to help messages. I’ve sent 3 with no responses.

tandem|us.t: Was functional when it was simple
tandem|us.c:
To start off, I don’t really leave reviews, let alone bad ones, but I’m kind of done with it. TLDR - Tandem seemingly has been focusing more on building out their MVP with new bells and whistles (features) but has been somehow neglecting the primary major error of its functioning parts of the app.

About a month ago all of my partner’s and my past splits got mixed into our recent splits we were planning to settle. Contacted customer support, they said they’d have it fixed (I sent them screenshots, etc.) and we waited for about 2 weeks with no resolution, we had to manually go through and decline/delete each duplicated transaction since we started using the app. (Even after that no one bothered to follow up.)

Recently none of my transactions for the past half month haven’t gone through and it’s really messing up my budgeting because I was relying on Tandem to at the least help with this part of it, now I have to go back to the old way of doing it and manually add the last half month of expenses to settle the current split we have open.

I have been messaging Tandem daily for almost a week now and no response still. “Typically responds in a few minutes” is such a lie.

Even if these are edge cases, not getting actual help and having them occurring not even that far apart is just becoming not worth it anymore. 

I’m considering removing my financial accounts from the app and just manually adding my transactions at this point.—Feels like a slight step up from using Excel/Sheets, but at least it would be more reliable and not negatively affect my budgeting.

tandem|us.t: Caused more problems than it solved for us
tandem|us.c: This app has made my partner and I’s financial journey MORE frustrating than before. First of all, both my partner and I tried emailing the Tandem contact email and got no response, so I wouldn’t rely on that if I were you. Secondly, if someone in your partnership changes their phone number, they have to delete their tandem account and create an entire new one. Thirdly, it’s way too difficult to view the history of your “settle-up’s”,  god forbid if you make a mistake and want to resettle. This app is not intuitively set up and gave both my partner and I meltdowns. A financial app **that I’m paying a subscription for** shouldn’t be so badly designed that I have to pop back open a Google spreadsheet, manually copy down all split transactions, and recalculate my split to actually split things correctly after we made a mistake. Get this app if you want to have financial meltdowns more often with your partner

This app was decent at first, but as soon as you need to make simple changes it immediately becomes unusable. Split summaries aren’t saved and past splits aren’t editable, so if you make a mistake or otherwise need to change a past split, you’re stuck doing that math by yourself. God forbid you change your phone number at any point - Tandem will never even pretend to help you. Without your phone number, you’ll have to delete your account, make a new account, have your partner delete your presence in their account, have your partner AND send a new invite just to lose prior data anyway. All because tandem won’t let you change your number in app!! If you try to contact customer service like I did, good luck. They say they’ll message you back and send their response via email, but I never heard anything from them. It’s been weeks at this point.

TL:DR save yourself the trouble and use one of the many other apps on the market. Maybe you can even find one with actual customer support!

This app is a game changer for couples managing finances. We switched from Honeydue and this app is a breath of fresh air in comparison - it just works. One huge piece of feedback - we currently have to do some magical things when we settle up. Since there's a pretty large balance in the app, sometimes we'd like to settle up only a certain amount (i.e. $100) rather than the full balance. We currently have to do this by going through all of the charges and manually choosing a combination that results in approximately the desired amount. Would be amazing to be able to enter a fixed amount to settle up like in Honeydue! No other complaints :)

I recently downloaded the app with my girlfriend and we’ve had issues trying to get her signed up and our accounts merged. I’ve messaged “Dan” from customer support and he’s only responded once about 3 weeks ago.
A little slow to load, but my boyfriend and I love using it. No more spreadsheets!!!
This has been a game changer for us. It’s SO easy to use and makes settling up so much faster.
I like how it pulls from your credit cards directly, makes it much easier mentally to split costs

I love this app, especially with the recurring bills feature, as we share a lot of monthly bills. It’s way better than Venmo-ing the same money back and forth. I do wish the transactions showed up quicker in the app, you have to pay for that feature. Overall, still useful.

Tandem is a decent service for tracking expenses between one other person. A recent update made it possible to see settle up history without premium which can be useful. 

An easier way to add and view notes for transactions is greatly appreciated. The insights don’t feel particularly useful yet.

tandem|us.t: Great app for learning to budget together
tandem|us.c: I think it’s an amazing app and it definitely helps with typical couple things. Do instead of having to ask all the time we just check the app.
Great app - a little laggy sometimes but has gotten better and better over time
This makes it so easy for my partner and I to split our expenses!!

This app is incredibly helpful for my fiancé and I as we move in together & try to split expenses without a shared account.

I appreciate the new features and functionality that they have rolled out. I have had some bugs but typically they work to resolve those ASAP which I appreciate.

tandem|us.t: Our go to for financial equality
tandem|us.c: My fiancé and have been using tandem for years and plan to continue using when we're married. It's easy, seamless, and makes it simple to adjust splits. The subscription was a no brainer!

My wife and I have been using tandem since moving in together, through our engagement, and now as a married couple. It makes sharing expenses and keeping track of monthly expenses super easy. We’ve also begun using the shared tasks feature and are liking it so far! Great app - highly recommend.

I like the premise of the app but one of the features I was looking forward to just doesn’t work. I wanted to create a goal of getting a dining table but not only will the Amazon link not work for the “import” feature but the custom button won’t let me put in a price for the item… What’s the point of it if you can’t put in a price? I looked for a button to add that, nope. Once created with picture and name all you can do is delete it. I’m disappointed… If that doesn’t work, I don’t think I want the app connected to my bank accounts…
Takes all the guessing/ estimating/ awkward money talk out of splitting expenses.

I’ve recently been living with my partner and had to learn to split expenses. We tried splitwise but we can never actually remember to put anything in. This has been super helpful to be able to look at transactions right in the app and select ones to split

Listen I only have the free version but the ability to set up several auto splits have saved my life! One day I might bite the bullet and just buy the paid version - I like that they show how much you’ll save with it.
Great app for splitting transactions and easily link different financial accounts to view all transactions. Also easy to manually account for things.

I’ve had a chance of using many different apps with the same reason.
I love how they did their solution, and love using it, very intuitive.

I love this app because it makes splitting expenses easier. However, my partner and I share a credit card, and the app doesn’t allow for expenses to be sorted by person and therefore shows every charge twice.
Great app so far. Clearly still young though. More customization for splits would be nice.

This is the only app that has stuck for me and my partner. You can tell it’s built around the use case of two people with shared expenses but not completely commingled finances, which is a lot of couples these days, but everything else has felt built for a lot of expenses in short succession like a trip or occasional expenses like roommates. The direct transaction connection feature is really the killer!

tandem|us.t: Good app with room for improvement
tandem|us.c: It’s a great app to use with my girlfriend. It’s a little slow to load but it’s exactly what we’re looking for. Easy to add transactions and split with s/o.

Instead of requesting a Venmo every time you go out or pay a bill, tandem makes it super easy to link credit cards/bank accounts and select how to split transactions. It’s pretty simple to use, but could be better if the app showed more data behind transactions (sometimes it mislabels a payment e.g. a purchase at a Columbia store was labeled as Columbia natural gas). Overall though, great app that takes makes it easy to split expenses between two people.

tandem|us.t: Super Convenient and Easy to Use
tandem|us.c: The easiest way for me and my partner to divide bills/costs. Love this app!

My girlfriend and I use this to balance all of our shared expenses. It’s great at doing that! Only downsides to the app is it can be pretty buggy and slow. All of my personal transactions appear 3 times, so it can be confusing if I added an expense or not.

It’s a great app which allows to add multiple bank accounts to the add/split costs. I can see the design updating with a smoother integration of bank accounts and expenses with are not only debited but credited to the account as well.
My partner and I are big fans

tandem|us.t: Great but could use some growth
tandem|us.c: I have only been using Tandem for a couple weeks and it’s been super helpful splitting amounts and adding charges directly from my accounts or manually adding other stuff. We do wish there was an option to add a photo of our receipts to the split to keep track of things in one place. Overall though it has been great. Very affordable cost to use also.
Super convenient way to keep track of splits for big and little purchases.
I adore this app! Best help with our budgeting with the new features as well!

tandem|us.t: Makes our life easier since moving in together
tandem|us.c:

We pay, forget about it, and it ends up working out that we never take money out to pay back but the math of us splitting back and forth works for us. Like having one bank account without the stress.
Tandem is my favorite app for splitting finances with my girlfriend. Highly recommend

My partner and I have been using Tandem for a little over a year now. The app works flawlessly and exactly how you’d want it to. I highly recommend it if you’re trying to figure out a way to track and split expenses between couples.

7 day free trial then you have to pay. I don’t use apps that don’t have a free option. Trials are just setups for when you don’t use the app, you still get charged. I was very much looking forward to seeing how this app worked.
Have to pay, nothing is free!
The app forces you to enter all of your personal information before forcing you to choose a payment option to even see the UI.
Love this app for splitting expenses!

This app is seriously a lifesaver. My partner and I both can’t remember a thing to save our souls. It has made “have I paid you for this yet?” “Heck honey I have no clue” a thing of the freaking past! Every couple of days or weeks I go in click on the new transactions and bota bing bota boom DONE! Theres even a button to push so tandem AUTOMAGICALLY splits reacquiring transactions! As someone who hates asking for someone else to pay them back this app has made it so I don’t have to anymore and all that anxiety is gone!
Really helps with my gf and I splitting bills
My partner and I downloaded tandem because she got tired of my Venmo request. It has made life much easier and has an amazing user interface. We love Tandem!

tandem|us.t: Great for splitting things with your SO!

Being able to make your own categories for the charges would be awesome as well. I’m talking like 5-7 days after I made a purchase which made it difficult to really keep track of what was being spent and what needed to be split between my husband and I. I’ve been following up. Nothing has happened. I can’t even use the app that I’ve been paying for.
Don’t get it if u got chime didn’t work for me
Tandem makes everything easier! We get to pick and choose what we want to treat each other with and what we want to split! My fiancée and I absolutely love it!

When my spouse and I were looking to split shared costs, I had no idea how I was going to keep track of everything. I thought “there must be an app for this” and sure enough, I stumbled across Tandem! I love that I can link all of my accounts and have a certain split ratio that remains constant, but also have the flexibility to add manual expanses and splits as well. It is simple to use and has made our lives so much easier. Thanks Tandem!
Great app for splitting expenses with partner. Allows you to share info and split expenses in any ratio, so convenient!

My partner and I have been using Tandem for about a year now and it’s been a huge game-changer for managing our expenses. No longer do we have to manually keep track of our transactions. Love that I can link all my credit cards and easily settle up via Venmo. Must have for couples who split expenses!

My partner and I used to have a shared Google sheet for managing expenses and it go so out of hand so quickly, especially since we live together. Now all our transactions are in one place and settling up is sooooo much easier.

I tried out a number of apps for keeping track of split expenses after my divorce but they all had major shortcomings. Tandem works very well for us. I love that you can connect it with directly to your credit cards and split something easily with a swipe. We have 3 kids and our decree mandates that all extracurricular-related costs and all medical costs are split 50/50, with a few odd items being reimbursable by my ex at 100%. This makes things SO easy for someone like with a very forgetful brain. 3 things I would add that would really make this app perfect: 1) ability to attach a picture of a receipt (even low res) for documentation/proof, 2) ability for the other person to see the notes I add to specific expense to help explain what it’s for, and 3) ability to customize the categories. Things like “bills”, “entertainment” or “food” don’t help me. In my case it would be extremely helpful to be able to add categories like medical, school, and extracurricular. 

All in all, though it’s not perfect, it’s the best I’ve been able to find at this price point.

A great app for partners! With all the different bills and big expenses, it can be hard to know what was paid. This helps keep things in order without worrying about if you or your partner paid. You can also adjust the split payment.
Tandem makes splitting living expenses so much easier than keeping track of an running total of who owes what.

tandem|us.t: Functions well for what it is!
tandem|us.c:
I’ve been using Tandem for about a month and have enjoyed how easy it is to enter and split expenses. I like how I can split by % or $ and can post expenses as both Requests and Payments. I have a few bits of feedback:

• The names of categories are not clickable (only the > arrow is) when entering expenses. I would love if the category labels were clickable. [EDIT: looks like this has been fixed recently!] 
 • I would love to create my own custom categories. 
 • The first time I downloaded the app, I was consistently forced into a “pay to use Tandem” screen. Since I uninstalled and reinstalled the app, I’ve had no issues. But had my partner not reached out to a friend to confirm the app was free, I would not have continued using the app.

My partner and I have been living together for several year now and when we moved in we had to manually keep track of shared expenses. We started off my sending the same $20 back and forth to each but eventually tried to keep a running list but frequently one of us would forget update. We got fed up and looked into ways of simplifying our finances and found Tandem! The simple tap system makes it easy to track and split purchases. My favorite feature is the ability to customize the split for when we open a drink tab and one of us decides to have a night and the other is the DD.

tandem|us.t: Perfect for Being Together but Financial Independent
tandem|us.c: After moving in with my partner, we were searching for something to keep all the bills straight. Tandem is perfect for balancing monthly bills and special purchases, allowing to reflect on our overall spending behavior.
Spouse and I have struggled splitting costs over time across different accounts. Tandem makes it easy to centralize expenses and share them with your partner

This app makes expense sharing for couples so easy. Before Tandem, we would struggle to split costs and relied on the “buy every other meal” approach, but little expenses add up and it’s hard to keep track! Tandem is a game changer for us!! We settle up less and feel confident expenses aren’t falling through the cracks. Also, though we split 50/50, the functionality to edit the split ratio seems really useful. We’ve recommended this to all our couple friends!
My fiancé and I used Tandem all the time to split our purchases!  It was super easy to use and helpful!
This is a great app. It allows me to budget plan things I need to do and also would like to do very well

tandem|us.t: Great intro for us before combing accounts
tandem|us.c: Tandem really helped me and my fiancé to budget and be on the same page with our spending / sharing, prepping us to share bank accounts efficiently!
Helped us organize all of our finances

When my boyfriend and I moved in together, we downloaded tandem and it is sooooo helpful for keeping track of how much we are spending!! I’m usually not a nickel and dimer, and believe “it all evens out eventually” with friends and family when it comes to money. However, since moving in together, we split utilities, furniture, groceries, etc.. let me tell you, it was NOT evening out.  I love how tandem can link directly to your bank account, so once a week all I have to do is go and swipe which transactions I’d like to split! Tandem automatically calculates the net difference between spenders. You can also adjust the split so that not every purchase is 50/50! My boyfriend and I split a lot of things 50/50, but for example, he really wanted a nicer set of speakers to go with our tv, where I really didn’t care much about it. We split the tv and speakers in a 70/30 split.  We love using tandem, it’s a stress free way to address money spending differences in a relationship/partnership!

Tandem is the ultimate app for couples to manage their finances together. With seamless synchronization, intelligent expense tracking, and customizable budgets, Tandem makes financial transparency and cooperation easy. Say goodbye to those "I thought you paid the bill" arguments. Its shared goals feature strengthens relationships, while robust security ensures peace of mind. Tandem transforms financial management into a shared journey of trust and achievement. Download Tandem today and elevate your financial harmony! It's like having a financial advisor who won't judge your impulse buys
My partner and I LOVE tandem. It’s so worth the membership to automate expenses.
Been using it with my partner and haven’t had any issues! You can only split things with 1 person as far as 8 know but works great for what I need it for.

My constant fear of financial insecurity keeps my head rattling. My partner was always avoidant due to his own anxieties around money. Those fears turned into resentment, arguing, and questioning. Tandem changed everything for us. It is simple enough to not overwhelm my partner, makes shopping and date night simple, and eased both of our discomfort. We’re stronger than ever, and can navigate all sorts of difficult conversations.
This app has majorly simplified our lives by allowing us to quickly and easily calculate what we owe each other as partners who live together and split our bills and expenses. Thanks Tandem!

This app has truly been a lifesaver, especially if you and your partner don’t share a bank account. No more arguing over Venmo, forgetting to request, or sifting through bank statements. This app does it all and calculates everything for you which is so helpful. I love how you can make comments on the charges too, to explain where you were, where you went, or why they owe you. So helpful. We will be using this forever!

My girlfriend and I started using tandem a few months ago and it’s been a huge asset for us to help balance our finances. We both love to eat out and travel (which can get expensive quick) so it’s helped us keep track of large and small expenses that we want to split. On a side note, since I only see my most recent transactions on the app across all my cards, the app has also helped me identify a fraud charge that would’ve taken me a while longer to identify otherwise. I truly think they’re the best in the market for this service and we’re very happy with the experience.
Tandem changes the game for splitting costs with your partner! User interface is simple but sleek enough to look like an Apple type product. So much better than the competitors out there!

This is the first app I’ve found that easily integrates and works with my partner to manage expenses. Goodbye spreadsheets, bad working apps, and lots of time figuring out how to fairly split expenses. Now it is all simplified with Tandem.
Great for splitting bills. You can include a percentage or certain amount to split transactions. Definitely helpful for organizing costs

tandem|us.t: Has been a life saver in our relationship
tandem|us.c:
It’s so nice to not have to nickle and dime each other every time we eat out but still feel like we’re each equitably contributing to bills. I love the ease of just swiping through on payday and and settling things up. 

One critique I have is that the savings goal only works if you use a bank account through tandem. This is kind of silly, since my partner and I already have a joint HYSA. I would love to use this feature, but am not interested in starting a new bank account.

It's been so hard to keep track of our joint bills and trying to go back-and-forth and page each other later. With Tandem, we are able to do the split whenever and settle up when convenient is made our our finances a breeze!
My partner and I have been using tandem since it came out and it’s saved us so much time and energy when it comes to splitting the bills. We love it

Me and my partner use tandem to help split groceries and restaurant bills, and it makes it so much easier than trying to constantly Venmo each other or split up costs. With tandem we can just balance books every month or so and it makes everything seem less stressful.

tandem|us.t: Great for splitting costs with a partner
tandem|us.c: The app makes it really easy to split costs and that way we don’t have to be sending money each other back and forth all the time. I appreciate that all my accounts are linked so I don’t have to look at my bank accounts or save receipts every time I buy something. I also like the option to split using different ratios. We used to split expenses 50/50 and now split 65/35. It was easy to change the ratio and it makes it convenient to not have to do the math every time we buy something together.
Me and my wife use this app every month to evenly split bills. So much easier to use than looking through our bank statements every month.

Tandem has been so easy for me and my partner to split our costs. We especially love being able to change the percentage of the split. Tandem recently improved being able to see the history of past charges/settlements. I recommend for anyone often sending money back and forth with another person.
Tandem is so helpful to my partner and I, it makes tracking and splitting expenses seamless!

tandem|us.t: The easiest way to split expenses!!
tandem|us.c: I LOVE tandem. My partner and I used to use Splitwise to split monthly living costs and this makes it SO much easier. Tandem automatically pulls in your credit purchases so you can just tap to split instead of manually entering the charges. It actually gives me time back and I don’t even dread doing my expenses anymore!! 10/10 recommend

This app has been so great for my girlfriend, and I know money is always a tough issue for a lot of couples. This really helps put things out in a very transparent manner and since we’ve had this app, we’ve been nothing but great!

This app is super useful for not having to constantly settle up on every little bill and purchase. It automatically keeps track by connecting to your credit card so you don’t have to manually input every expense.

Tandem helps my partner and I stay on top of all of our expenses. I love that you can schedule recurring expenses to split automatically and set a predetermined split percentage so you don’t have to do so much manual work for each expense — you literally just swipe. Previously, we used splitwise and venmo and it was so much work each time we had to go back through bank and credit card statements that sometimes my partner would just give up and not charge me for things. This has been tremendously helpful! The only thing I’d wish to see is better transaction history in the free version — once one of us settles up in the app, we can no longer look at expenses. My partner likes to go through Tandem once a month while I go through it weekly, so whenever he settles the balance, I can’t review what he charged or payed me for.

Before using tandem my boyfriend and I would have to go through all our big split expenses and put them in spreadsheet just to figure out how to go about splitting them. Now everything is directly put into tandem and it makes seeing what we owe each other the easiest thing ever. This app has saved us so much time!! 💳😁

tandem|us.t: Made my relationship better than ever!!
tandem|us.c: The easiest way to split bills!!! Didn’t want to commitment yet of a joint account, but wanted the ease of splitting expenses. With the ability to split by percentages, we are able to go by how much we make each week so the relationship stays fair!! I cannot thank the creators enough for giving me the time to enjoy my relationship instead of spending time splitting bills.

I live with my partner and we split expenses for rent, utilities, food, cats, and more. I love how easily Tandem connects to all my banking accounts and credit cards to have one combined feed of all my and his expenses ordered by date. They have accurate descriptions too, so you can easily scroll through and choose which charges to split. You can also customize splits if you don’t want it to be 50/50, and you can set up recurring splits for regular things like rent and internet. We try to go through once a month and make sure we’ve added everything, and Tandem will do the math and say who owes what balance. There is a link to settle up directly with venmo or enter other types of payements manually which will reset the balance owed to zero. 10/10 would recommend, makes life so much easier!

tandem|us.t: Keeps us on track and accountable for spending
tandem|us.c: My partner and I love using tandem and we’ve recommended it to other couples who share finances but not bank accounts. It’s so simple to use and cuts out so much stress when trying to keep up with who owes who how much for what and when!

My partner and I have been really happy with this app. It’s very purpose driven, so if your goal is to split bills, then it works perfectly. If you’re trying to incorporate other types of financial planning and budgeting, then it might not have what you need. I personally like that fact that it isn’t trying to do everything and is simple and straightforward.

Tandem is a must have app for any couples that share expenses! Tandem allows you to split and track your expenses with your significant other. Gone are the headaches that come with constant Venmos, Excel tracking, and just “calling it even.” We love Tandem!!!
It’s made keeping track of who owes who very easy!

This app changed the game for our relationship finances. We used to have to use manual google sheets that were hard to keep up with and clunky. Now, the bank and credit card integrations work so smoothly, it's such a breeze to share our expenses!

My partner and I already struggled to do this. He’s generally skeptical of introducing new apps into our flow, but Tandem has been great. I can’t see us switching. Looking forward to seeing more things come from this great team.

I got an ad to beta test tandem and it came at the perfect time. Tandem makes keeping track of shared expenses easy and simple. Withholding a star for issues with some credit cards not linking properly and getting unlinked but have appreciated the speed of customer service.

This app is perfect for splitting expenses with my partner. The linked credit card feature is awesome so we don’t have to constantly be remembering who paid for what. Usually we add expenses as they come and then settle up at the end of the month. Really takes the stress out of cost sharing. There’s no other apps like it. Totally different format from Splitwise and Venmo and really geared partner who are constantly splitting things. 

I could see this being used for roommates, best friends, siblings as well. Any two person team that needs to split expenses on a regular basis-this app is perfect.

Tandem has revolutionized the way we handle our finances as a couple. My partner and I are thrilled with its performance! The app makes budgeting, saving, and tracking expenses incredibly straightforward and effective. We appreciate the ability to set joint financial goals and monitor our progress together. The high-yield savings account offering 4.70% interest is a fantastic perk. The user-friendly interface is both clean and intuitive, and setting up the app was a breeze. Tandem has truly made our financial management simpler and brought us closer to achieving our financial aspirations. Highly recommended for all couples!

tandem|us.t: Great app to easily split expenses
tandem|us.c:
There were many things that my partner and I were pay for and would forget to settle up or would just write it off since there was activation energy to check the statement and add it to another app. Since using tandem, I realized I’ve been taking on nearly $1000+ in expenses each month that I wasn’t splitting out of inconvenience or forgetting.
The reason this review is 4 stars and not 5, is the features are simple and the UI takes a little to get used to. There are not ways to see categories in spending or I’d like to see all my transactions and then next to them if they’ve been split or not vs 2 screens now.
Gets the job done

My husband and I absolutely love this app! We’ve tried other apps but this is straightforward and easy to use to help us keep track of our joint expenses. My wishlist is for manual expenses to have a field to put in date because sometimes we put in multiple expenses a few days later, so I think a date option helps keep things more organized. But other than that, this app is great!

As a couple, we love this app and think it’s the best choice we’ve found so far in this category to help us with splitting finances! We previously tried Splitwise but found it very tedious to individually enter in each translation, so having our transactions automatically imported was a game changer for us. I used to dread spending time splitting our finances, but the ability to simply swipe left or right on transactions to include them completely changed my perspective! We also are grateful for the custom split option - this is an essential feature for us as we like to get pretty granular sometimes, and this one is easy to use. 

I do only give this app a 4 though because we’ve been long time users and have noticed some small bugs here and there that make it less perfect than we’d like. Some examples: the transactions list will take long to load or not load all items, it has duplicated all items in this split list forcing us to go through and delete all duplicates, and sometimes the custom split won’t save unless we use the % split instead of the decimal split. 

We have been using it long enough though that we have seen the active efforts from the developers to make this app even better and less glitchy, so that’s definitely appreciated. Its cool to see all the upgrades it’s been given since we started using it. 

We did pay for the premium version for a while, mainly because we needed to see our entire history (anything pre settle-ups) and that is unfortunately behind the paywall. But, we found that we didn’t really use many of the premium features, so we’ve now downgraded. It’s a cheap subscription, so worth it if you feel like just supporting the company / devs which is what we did for a while. 

Overall, an awesome app and something we will continue to use for a long time!! Highly recommend to couples looking for a tool that makes splitting your finances much easier.
This app makes splitting expenses so much easier! Easy to use. Easy to split the expenses and track spending.
Instead of keeping track in a google sheet every month. Tandem makes splitting things that much easier. Recommended for any couple splitting bills.
Great way to keep track and split expenses with my partner! Not a big fan of the new savings account feature currently. I would much prefer to open a savings account outside the app

I pay all the bills and use Tandem to keep track of splits. Before, I kept a note and tried to keep track of transactions. I saw an ad for Tandem and it’s so much easier. Love connecting to Venmo easily and it makes life easy!

This has saved my relationship! No more sticky conversations about who paid for what and the other feeling that they are taking on the majority of the dinners. It is so easy to use and allows you to change split percentages and amounts so one can choose to indulge without break the others bank!

tandem|us.t: The solution we’ve been looking for!
tandem|us.c: My boyfriend and I used to be so annoyed having to keep track of who spent what and when. We had an inconsistent Notes file and a messy back-and-forth Venmo routine that just wasn’t cutting it anymore, especially after we moved in together and shared additional expenses. I randomly saw and ad online for Tandem and was so excited that there was a solution to our struggle! The app is easy to use, connects to all my accounts and we’re now paying each other back once a month instead of every other day. 5 stars from us – we will never go back!
This app is easy to use and has made splitting living expenses with my partner a breeze. Prevents us from forgetting expenses we should split and allows for custom splits if needed, which is helpful.

Tandem makes it so easy to split costs. We don’t even care who puts their card down because we put everything in the app. 

Super easily connected with Venmo too. Would totally recommend

It is so much nicer to simply swipe a few transactions rather than go through my banking app and individually add up everything to put into Venmo. Plus the fact that each transaction is individually marked means there’s never an awkward convo about the price of anything.

tandem|us.t: Great App for Couples and Roommates
tandem|us.c: My partner and I have been using this app for a few months and it has saved us a lot of effort and time. It is like having a tab so that we don’t have to Venmo or Zelle each other every time we share an expense. I particularly appreciate the ability to import transactions from my credit card, and change the split ratio to 50%/50%, 70%/30% or any other ratio for both individual transactions or the tab as a whole. It has been a bit glitchy at times but overall it’s great! I highly recommend if you and someone else don’t want to Venmo each other every 5 minutes anymore.

My partner and I use tandem to split all our transactions and it makes it easy! 
Transactions are listed the following day so you can stay very up to date. Would be cool to add receipts but you can add notes when changing the split percentage (by dollar or percentage)
Would recommend!

tandem|us.t: Makes dealing with finances so easy!
tandem|us.c: This is a time and life saver. Makes it so easy and seamless

This app has made splitting finances easy for me and my fiancé! We started using Tandem when we moved in together and it has alleviated a lot of financial stress and confusion. The app helps us to keep track of expenses and allows us to create custom splits for certain expenses (e.g., 60/40% or 50/50% and everything in between). I could not recommend this app more highly!
This changed the game, I couldn’t imagine doing my finances without it!

The upgrades imo are not worth the subscription as it only updates right away from Visa (and even that sometimes does not work). The swipe to split and link with Plaid is nice and better than using Splitwise for me and my boyfriend!

Overall this is a great app and my partner and I use it everyday. The recent updates have been a bit of a letdown as they introduced some delays and bugginess, but the general concept of the app is super useful and has simplified how my partner and I split finances. I’d recommend this app to any couple and I look forward to future updates that improve the load time lag of the app, as well as some further functionality to support detailed metrics about spending categories.

tandem|us.t: Great for splitting expenses as a couple!

This app is perfect for any couple or roommates that share expenses!y fiancé and I use it while apartment living and it’s so easy and user friendly. I love how it automatically loads transactions and how you can set recurring expenses for each month. Highly recommend Tandem to everyone!

Partner and I found this easy to sue for splitting expenses. We did have difficultly adding them to the account. Took longer and wasn’t as easy as we needed it to be. Also the trial period was too short given we had difficultly connecting both accounts. It’s been working well minus that.
My partner & I switched to tandem a couple years ago and it makes splitting expenses so easy. It’s also a great tool to review your monthly credit card expenses

This app makes financial planning and decisions easier and automatic. The auto split feature makes it so that I don’t even have to think about splitting a bill, and the percentage auto split is helpful for me and my partner so that financial burden weighs equally ok us based on our income. I feel responsible and aware of mine and my partners finances.

The Tandem app is a lifesaver for splitting expenses with my partner! Its sleek and user-friendly design makes it super easy to track shared costs, whether it’s for a dinner, rent, or a trip. You can split bills evenly or customize amounts, and the app keeps everything transparent and organized. I love this app! Makes splitting things a breeze.
Super easy to use, all you do is swipe through transactions vs inputting everything manually. Been using it for over a year, just renewed. Worth over it any of the free apps out there

This is an amazing app for splitting expenses. So much easier than manually entering everything in splitwise and great when you also need to add expenses manually or splitting them not 50/50. Would highly recommend if any couple doesn’t want to get a card together. You get to keep your CC points while only taking a few minutes to split your monthly expenses!

tandem|us.t: Great app for splitting expenses! A little glitchy though.

Great app for tracking and splitting your charges with your partner!

My partner and I have been using Tandem for a while and I’ve kept up with it since they first started! We have seen the growth within the app and the value that it has and I would definitely recommend!!

My partner and I love the Tandem app. We were constantly forgetting to split purchases, forgetting what we agreed to split, and ultimately resenting finance discussions together. Other than that, we really like the app and use it every month to settle up.
Great app for splitting costs and keeping track of things.
Love how the app pulls transactions from our credit cards so that we don’t have to manually enter each item. It’s saved me and my partner so much time and made settling up easy!

When splitting expenses with your partner ,wether it’s rent or groceries,  tandem makes it super way to keep track of it all. No need to keep track or receipts or use an excel sheet. Very easy to use. Does the job

This app has made splitting everything from bills, nights out, and so much more easier than ever for my partner and I. No more guessing how much we owe or going back and forth on paying for things. Been using this app for years and don’t know what I would do without it!

Would rate as 4.5😊

This is really great for me and my partner who don’t ever really pay each other back, but do our best to keep things even. It allows us to easily split our expenses and see who is more in the red. There have been some minor bugs  it is a newer app but overall has been a great help!
good tracking for exactly what i was looking for!

So simple in the best way! Tandem does exactly what we need it to: split selected transactions 50/50 and settle up (the new goal setting feature is also an addition we'll use!). UI is lovely and I rarely notice any bugs. Recommend for couples.
Easy and simple app that is great for couples who live together and need a way to split expenses. Fills a niche that was much needed.

tandem|us.t: Essential tool for when you move in together
tandem|us.c: After moving in with my partner, Tandem made splitting expenses super easy, accurate and transparent. I can’t imagine doing this all manually!

My partner and I are happy we switched from trying to keep track of expenses in our heads and venmoing the same $40 back and forth to this awesome app. It’s easy to use and great for sharing any type of expense! I just wish it was more compatible with Apple credit cards but the ability to add expenses by hand is easy enough for those expenses.

Before I started using tandem, I was making a spreadsheet and literally writing in all of the shared expenses between my partner and I. It was a lot of manual labor, at least an hour of my time per month, and my partner never knew how much money he owed me until I took the time to do this. I’ve been using Tandem for nearly a year and it has completely automated keeping track of shared expenses. I also love that you can change the split on expenses if one partner tends to pay more. I love this app, it has helped create so much transparency about money in my relationship without having to share bank accounts. I highly recommend this to anyone who stresses about keeping track of shared expenses. One feature I would love is the option to pay a lump sum of your choice rather than pay for specific purchases.

Tandem has helped me immensely in ensuring that my SO and I are equally splitting expenses. I always whip out my card first and it turns out I do it at a rate of over $250 a month; which didn’t used to get split properly. Now it is easy to check the app and decide who picks up the tab to keep it even. The Venmo function is a great way to even up the tab as well.

For a small price, Tandem makes it very easy to split expenses between myself & my partner without opening new bank accounts — sleek, simple interface. Company is open to feedback — still working on some enhancements users have requested. Highly recommend though!

tandem|us.t: Life Saver for Couples Who Split Constantly!
tandem|us.c: My partner and I have been using this app for almost a year and it has saved us HOURS of math and receipt shuffling! Super easy and convenient!

Tandem is perfect for couples who don’t want the hassle of using Venmo or Splitwise, but aren’t at the point of combining finances or opening shared accounts. Tandem tracks all purchases and does the math for you. We’ve been using it for 2 years and no longer have to think twice about splitting expenses!

My girlfriend and I just celebrated our 5 year anniversary and have been using this since we moved in together 1.5 years ago. We hook it up to any cards or accounts we use, and when a charge appears that we want to split, we swipe it to the other person. We have it set to 50/50 but I love that you have to option to change that if you have different incomes. When my partner gets the charge from me, he clicks on it and it takes him to Venmo to pay me the amount owed. We mostly use it for utilities or if we want to split dinner or an event cost. They recently added a savings account with a pretty high APY where you can separate the money into specific goals that you are saving for. It’s nice to have the ability to split costs and save money all in the same app. Overall we love the app and it’s better to use than just a cash exchange app because 1. You don’t have to remember to pay someone, it just shows up in the app automatically, and 2. It does all the splitting math for you!

Tandem has been the best and easiest budgeting/split app for us as a couple. 5/5 def recommend 🤗

My partner and I really struggled on balancing finances with who paid what and didn’t want to have to venmo back and forth all the time. Once we found Tandem, shared finances became a whole lot easier for us and they continue to add new features!

Tandem helped me so much with sharing expenses with my partner. We are able to keep track of who’s card was used on what purchases and then settle a total amount once per month. It took away the stress of Venmo/zelle!

tandem|us.t: Great app to figure out finances!
tandem|us.c: My partner and I wanted to find out how to more equitably split our finances without dealing with bank accounts, Excel, and constant Venmo and Tandem has filled the niche so well! One easy swop and our percentages are set, boom, tallied up. Settling up is a breeze and I love the ability to set a share save goal together for big purchases. Here’s for a vacation soon 🤞🏼

tandem|us.t: Made going through bills with my partner so much easier!

tandem|us.t: Perfect for Managing Finances as a Couple!

Being able to just swipe and add the expense to our splits is so easy and helpful. He was the one who found Tandem, and while I was hesitant at first, I found myself absolutely loving it. I could connect all my cards and easily split up what I needed to between the two of us. Especially in the cases where a transaction wasn’t an even 50/50 split, Tandem does the math for you to make sure you’re splitting things evenly for you. 

With the new update too, it reminds me to go back into the app after I settle the bill on Venmo, so that way I’m not racking up new charges before settling the old one. With that update, easily knocks the app into a 10/10!

I also like their new shared goals savings account. Definitely want to try that out next!

tandem|us.t: This app is simply a no-brainer!
tandem|us.c:
My girlfriend and I like to keep our finances very organized, and as we don’t want to put everything in a joint bank account, keeping track of the expenses was a bit of a nightmare. 

We literally used to use a spreadsheet- $100 for a grocery bill, $50 for WiFi, $50 for an Amazon order- and do it piecemeal. It was a giant pain, so finding this app felt like such a relief! 

It’s easy to use with a simple interface. It’s incredibly easy to link your bank and credit cards, put transactions in the Tandem “tab”, and see who owes what after all expenses are taken into account. It’ll even take you straight to Venmo so you can send a payment, and settle all those transactions.

We do Premium, which is fantastic because it keeps a running history of all the split transactions you’ve accounted for. No more guessing about if I paid her for the laundry yet! 

The new Goals feature is also pretty neat. Getting to have a shared high yield savings account that we can both contribute, which you can set auto-deposits into, is great for our shared savings goals! 

I never write reviews for apps, but Tandem is one that we love, and feel like every couple should at least try. It feels like the app’s creators know exactly what it’s like to be in a financially-equitable relationship, and it truly reflects in the great experience we’ve had.

The Tandem app has saved my partner & I from hundreds of annoying back & forth Venmo transactions. Splitting costs now takes no thought as we just remind eachother to “just put it on tandem”. Can’t wait for what the future enhancements bring!

My husband and I did a lot of research on the best way for us to combine our finances, which can look different for every modern couple. We finally found Tandem, which helps us to fairly split the costs of our day to day expenses, and track it with ease. It is an indispensable tool for us

tandem|us.t: Great in theory, but not working for us
tandem|us.c:
We’ve used Splitwise for a few years to track expenses and didn’t want to pay for premium, so we started exploring similar apps. Tandem seemed awesome and we happily paid the fee for the first year. Unfortunately, after using it for a few weeks, we’ve realized there are a lot of issues. 

Firstly, one day I noticed no transactions had shown up in days. For some reason it just stopped importing data from my accounts. So I had to unlink everything and reinstall and set my accounts up again. But now, there are tons of duplicate charges, which makes it incredibly confusing. Tough to keep track of what has already been split and what hasn’t. 

I requested a refund because of these issues and support said they’d work on it. It’s been a few days and I’m hoping they make good on that. 

If these issues are fixed in the future I’d love to revisit it. It’s a super promising service and I like the interface a lot, it just didn’t function the way it should for us.

split-paytogether|us.t: Great way to pay - Doesn’t disclose the service fee
split-paytogether|us.c:
Here’s the scenario, You invite a group of your friends for dinner.

You get a text that someone wanted to bring their cousin and their friends. It’s all good, you met them once.

Y’all have dinner and it’s time to pay, BOOM, you offer to use your card to pay and there’s a way everyone can send you their part all in one place. Scan the receipt, generate the link or QR code and send it to the group chat.

Your party of 12 pays in less than 5 minutes.

That cousin and friend that you barely know, scan this QR code, select your items and pay in seconds. EASY!

The app even shows you who paid, what is outstanding and collects everything until it’s ready to cash out.

Here’s the sad part. Before a recent update (July 2026) there wasn’t a service charge for the “pay through the app” feature. 

I was doing an even split of a bill with a few friends. They knew the drill, they waited for me to do my thing and send them the link.

I told them what they had to pay on their end, sent them the link and they were confused why it was charging them something’s different.

Lo and behold the payment screen was updated and there was an itemized list with a 5% service charge.

There was no warning, update message or indicator on my end.

I never would have known if my friend hadn’t showed me.

It just felt very sneaky and lowkey was kinda embarrassing after hyping up the app. 

Basically, the app charges this fee to everyone of your guests using this feature and then (I assume when available) charge you a service fee when cashing out the payments instantly

I mean hey, the app works wonders if you and your friends don’t mind paying more. 

It would be cool if you had the option assign items to a person instead of having them pick them out. This way we could use the app and bypass using the service charge feature. There are apps that do this already. 

Overall, great app but I’ll stick the apps that won’t charge a fee.

Unless you have the funds to pay the entire bill in your account already do not use this app. Went out with friends and we all tried it cause I thought it was cool and once I tried to withdraw the money everyone sent me it told me it'll arrive in 3-5 days (it took 5). My buddy ended up having to foot the whole bill after everyone already basically paid so I had to send it back to him later once I got it.

App was excellent, until they started charging fees. When you send a split the person that needs to pay you will be charge around 5% for the payment to be processed, which seems high. Something around 1-3% would be more reasonable. I now only use this app to split up the payments and ask people to just Zelle me. It was really cool that people could use their credit card to pay you, but I don’t think most people would be willing to pay an additional fee to the money they owe you especially on more expensive items or bills. For example if you use the split up to copay for a subscription every month that person would be paying an additional fee for the subscription.

I’ve done multiple tests to see how it works and you know what it’s amazing and so easy to use. But the thing I didn’t like was the service fee.  If it was a flat fee like $1 or $2 I’ll give it a pass.  For the fee to be around 5% of the final price is crazy. If it was a very large group like 10-15 people I don’t think ppl would mind the fee. Goin for 4-8 people it would be harder to swallow that fee.

TL;DR: Monarch has some good ideas and is generally well designed, but for $15/month it gets several basic things wrong: the trial is too short, auto-categorization is unreliable, rule priority is opaque, and category/budget organization is unnecessarily confusing and restrictive.

Full Review:
Monarch is feature-rich and mostly well designed, but several fundamental blunders seriously degrade the experience and make me question how a $15/month, award-winning budgeting app can get some of the basics so wrong.

First, the 7-day free trial is far too short and feels greedy. This is a budgeting app built around monthly budgeting. You realistically need at least one full budgeting cycle to understand how transactions, rules, rollovers, recurring expenses, and actual spending behave over time. Seven days is barely enough to finish setting everything up, much less evaluate whether the product actually works for you.

Second, auto-categorization needs to be rock solid at this price, and it simply isn’t. Monarch categorized a Baskin-Robbins purchase as a coffee shop. Baskin-Robbins. One of the most recognizable ice cream chains in America. As a coffee shop. That is the budgeting-app equivalent of categorizing McDonald’s as a hot dog stand. Mistakes happen, sure, but errors this basic seriously undermine confidence in the system.

The rule system is unnecessarily opaque and inflexible. Rules apparently execute in top-to-bottom order, with the first overlapping rule winning, yet this hierarchy is not made clear in the UI. Worse, there is no way to reorder rules. If rule priority matters to the outcome, users need both a clear indication of that priority and direct control over it.

Category organization is another mess. Categories exist within groups, yet the settings UI presents groups and categories together in a flat list at essentially the same visual level, even though they are fundamentally different objects. Group ordering should be clearly separated from category ordering within each group. Reordering itself also seems buggy, with changes sometimes failing to persist, and it is unclear how the order configured there relates to the ordering shown in the Budget tab. This entire interaction needs a rethink.

Finally, Flexible budget items appear to be automatically ordered by spending level, with no obvious way to manually reorder the groups and categories. Why? A premium budgeting app should not be making an arbitrary presentation decision like this with no override. Fully unconstrained category and group ordering is a basic organizational feature, not an advanced request.

There is a lot to like about Monarch, which makes these shortcomings surprising and more frustrating. The app is close to being excellent, but at $15/month the standard should be much higher. Basic categorization accuracy, understandable rule precedence, reliable reordering, and full control over budget organization should already be solved problems.
